items.title: 油價恐飆每桶200美元？全球石油庫存告急、高盛：風險溢價逼近「歷史最高」
paras: 全球石油市場正逐步失去應對供應衝擊的緩衝空間。在長達7個月的戰事消耗下，全球原油與成品油庫存持續下降，石油業高層警告，西方市場已幾乎沒有額外庫存可供動用。一旦荷姆茲海峽航運再度受阻，油價恐面臨更劇烈的上漲壓力。
全球最大獨立石油貿易商Vitol執行長Russell Hardy本周在倫敦能源情報論壇上表示，西方市場已沒有更多庫存可以消耗，並警告，若荷姆茲海峽航運中斷，極端情境下油價可能衝上每桶200美元。
高盛大宗商品研究團隊則在最新報告中坦言，沿用多年的布蘭特原油定價模型今年已出現明顯失準，主因是原有模型主要追蹤經濟合作暨發展組織（OECD）商業庫存，未能充分反映非OECD國家的庫存變化，而本輪全球石油庫存消耗近60%正是來自這些國家。
高盛重新建構模型，將全球非OECD庫存納入分析後發現，9月布蘭特原油的風險溢價平均達每桶22美元，創有紀錄以來第二高水準，僅次於今年4月的歷史峰值，也遠高於2022年俄烏戰爭期間、未超過每桶16美元的高點。
這反映出，在全球石油庫存持續下降、供應緩衝空間日益有限之際，市場正為潛在的供應中斷風險支付接近歷史高點的溢價。

全球石油庫存消耗6.6億桶 供應緩衝能力逼近極限

石油市場面臨的壓力，已不僅是原油供應減少，更在於庫存緩衝能力逐步耗盡。能源分析師John Kemp在最新報告中指出，全球原油與成品油庫存已降至難以抵禦進一步衝擊的水準。
根據美國能源資訊署（EIA）10月短期能源展望，自今年3月以來，全球石油庫存累計減少約6.6億桶，其中近60%來自非OECD國家的儲油設施。
高盛追蹤的可見庫存數據也顯示，截至8月底，自3月1日以來的累計消耗量已達5.09億桶。
美國戰略石油儲備（SPR）同樣持續下降。EIA最新數據顯示，美國SPR本周再減少78.4萬桶，降至2.83億桶，距離1982年設立以來的歷史最低水準僅約1,300萬桶。
面對供應壓力，多國上周宣布額外釋出1億桶緊急石油儲備，加上先前已宣布的4億桶，試圖緩解市場緊張情勢。
不過，摩根大通首席石油策略師Natasha Kaneva指出，最新宣布的1億桶並非全數屬於新增干預，其中相當一部分是延續國際能源總署（IEA）先前公布的釋儲計畫，而非額外增加供應量。
換言之，市場獲得的新增供應支援，可能不如公告數字所呈現的規模。

高盛原油定價模型失準 非OECD庫存成關鍵變數

高盛坦言，沿用多年的布蘭特原油定價模型，今年已無法充分解釋油價變動，主要原因在於模型過度依賴OECD商業石油庫存，忽略了非OECD國家在本輪庫存消耗中所占的重要比重。
過去的歷史數據顯示，自1998年以來，OECD商業庫存可以解釋布蘭特原油1個月與36個月期貨價差超過60%的變動。然而，今年以來，兩者之間的關係明顯失準：原油期限價差上升約每桶30美元，OECD商業庫存卻幾乎沒有變化。
高盛認為，問題在於大量庫存消耗發生於OECD以外的市場。儘管波斯灣石油出口量，包括部分未列入一般統計的石油流量，已恢復至2025年平均水準或更高，布蘭特現貨價格仍維持在每桶100美元以上，反映全球可見庫存已接近2017年以來的歷史低點。
為改善模型，高盛將全球OECD以外的陸上石油庫存納入計算。調整後的模型對原油期限價差的解釋能力有所提升，但仍有部分價格變動無法解釋，而這部分差距便被視為市場對供應風險的額外定價。
高盛也發現，不同地區的庫存變動對油價影響並不相同。OECD商業庫存每減少1億桶，布蘭特原油的合理價格估值約提高每桶8美元；其他可見全球陸上庫存若減少相同數量，估值則僅提高約每桶2美元。
原因在於，布蘭特與西德州中級原油（WTI）的基準合約，實物交割地均位於OECD國家，市場對這些基準原油的定價，因而更容易受到當地可見庫存變化影響。

9月風險溢價達22美元 高於俄烏戰爭期間高峰

納入非OECD庫存後，高盛估算，9月布蘭特原油的月均風險溢價達每桶22美元，為有紀錄以來第二高，僅次於2026年4月的峰值。
若仍沿用僅追蹤OECD商業庫存的舊模型，9月風險溢價甚至會被估算為每桶29美元。但高盛認為，這種方法無法充分掌握OECD以外實體石油市場的緊張程度。
相較之下，2022年俄烏戰爭爆發後，原油市場的月度風險溢價高峰仍未超過每桶16美元。兩者差距凸顯今年石油供應衝擊的嚴重程度。
高盛將當前風險溢價歸納為三大因素。
首先，地緣政治緊張加劇供應中斷疑慮。風險溢價與布蘭特原油看漲選擇權偏斜度，以及地緣政治風險指數的相關係數均約為0.5，顯示市場對極端供應情境的避險需求升高。
其次，投機性多頭部位持續推升油價。今年以來，金融市場上的原油期貨部位，也就是俗稱的「紙桶」，成為價格上漲的推動因素之一，相關係數約為0.6。
第三，宏觀資產配置的避險需求也改變了原油的市場定位。當石油供應衝擊推高通膨與美國公債殖利率時，原油可能成為股票與債券投資組合的避險工具。
本周美國10年期公債殖利率已升至5.3%以上，布蘭特原油與10年期美債殖利率的相關性接近25年來高點，原油與股市的相關性則大幅下降。

多重供應風險同時上升、高盛維持油價基準預測  但不排除進一步上漲

過去一周，全球石油市場接連遭遇多重供應衝擊。
中東方面，卡達附近油輪遇襲，伊朗革命衛隊攻擊液化石油氣油輪，曼德海峽也傳出布雷消息；阿拉伯聯合大公國則救出波斯灣起火油輪上的22名船員。
美國墨西哥灣約63%的石油產量因颶風Isaias而停擺，俄羅斯主要燃料出口樞紐也據報遭烏克蘭無人機襲擊。
儘管川普表示，期中選舉前不會對伊朗動武，並稱普丁同意釋出部分柴油，但油輪遇襲事件仍持續發生，外交解決前景不明。
Jefferies警告，在供應緩衝空間幾近耗盡之際，即使小規模中斷，也可能引發油價劇烈波動。
儘管市場風險升高，高盛目前仍維持原有基準情境，預期隨著供應逐步適應衝擊，原油風險溢價將逐漸回歸歷史平均的零水準。該行也指出，中東石油供應的恢復情況持續優於預期。
然而，高盛同時警告，只要地緣政治局勢未能明確緩解，風險溢價就可能維持高檔，現有油價預測也存在上行風險。
高盛上月已調高布蘭特原油價格預測，並指出若荷姆茲海峽運輸中斷延續至2027年，油價最高可能觸及每桶120美元。

items.title: 晶片買得到、錢卻更難找！博通執行長點破AI擴張難題
items.title_en: Chips Are Obtainable, But Money Is Even Harder to Find! Broadcom CEO Pinpoints AI Expansion Challenge
paras: AI擴張最怕的，可能已不是缺晶片，而是錢不夠。博通(AVGO-US)執行長陳福陽周一(12日)表示，取得資金如今已成為AI成長的最大限制。隨著建置與擴充AI系統的成本逐年攀升，籌措資金正變得比取得晶片更困難。
博通為大型資料中心供應客製化AI晶片與網路零組件，客戶包括開發及營運先進AI模型的企業，相關產品需求依然強勁。公司先前已將截至2027年10月止年度的AI晶片營收展望上調至約1,150億美元，並預期2028會計年度將達約2,300億美元。
然而，需求強勁不代表擴建計畫就能順利推進。資料中心在開始創造收入之前，企業就得先投入大筆資金，支付建築、運算設備及網路設施等成本，投資回報卻可能要等上數年。
許多企業仰賴舉債支應這些支出，但利率上升推高借款成本，投資人也更加仔細檢視獲利、穩定現金流，以及能否明確說明如何回收投資。從AI開發商、雲端服務供應商到資料中心營運商，都面臨同一個問題：未來創造的收入，是否足以支撐眼前的龐大投入？
即使取得晶片，也不代表運算產能能立即增加。資料中心還需要穩定供電、合適用地及完工的建築，任何一個環節延誤，都可能讓計畫停滯，即便晶片已經備妥也不例外。
陳福陽發表上述看法之際，科技業即將陸續公布最新財報，AI支出預料仍將是企業投資計畫的重心。不過，利率攀升與企業債務增加，可能讓這些擴張計畫承受更大壓力。
他的談話反映出AI產業成長瓶頸的轉變。過去市場主要擔心晶片供應能否跟上需求，如今焦點則轉向企業是否有能力負擔擴張成本。
未來能以合理成本取得資金，並將龐大支出轉化為穩定回報的企業，可能最有能力加速擴張；籌資與投資回收能力不足的業者，即使面對強勁AI需求，也可能被迫放慢腳步。
paras_en: AI expansion’s biggest fear may no longer be a chip shortage but a lack of money. Broadcom (AVGO-US) CEO Hock Tan said on Monday (the 12th) that securing financing has become the greatest constraint on AI growth. As the cost of building and scaling AI systems rises year after year, raising capital is becoming harder than obtaining chips.

Broadcom supplies custom AI chips and networking components to large data centers, serving customers that develop and operate advanced AI models, and demand for its related products remains strong. The company has already raised its AI chip revenue outlook for the fiscal year ending October 2027 to roughly $115 billion and expects fiscal 2028 revenue of about $230 billion.

However, strong demand does not guarantee that expansion plans will proceed smoothly. Before data centers can generate revenue, companies must first invest large sums in construction, compute hardware and networking infrastructure, and the return on that investment may not materialize for several years.

Many firms rely on borrowing to fund these expenditures, but rising interest rates have pushed up borrowing costs, and investors are scrutinizing profitability, stable cash flow, and whether companies can clearly explain how they will recoup their investments. AI developers, cloud service providers and data‑center operators all face the same question: will future revenue be sufficient to support the massive upfront outlays?

Even when chips are secured, compute capacity does not instantly increase. Data centers also need reliable power, suitable sites and completed buildings; any delay in one of these elements can stall a project, even if the chips are ready.

Tan made these remarks as the tech sector prepares to release its latest earnings, with AI spending still expected to be a core focus of corporate investment plans. Yet higher rates and rising corporate debt could put additional pressure on these expansion projects.

His comments reflect a shift in the bottleneck to AI industry growth. In the past, the market mainly worried about whether chip supply could keep pace with demand; now the focus has moved to whether companies can afford the cost of expansion.

Companies that can obtain financing at reasonable costs and turn large expenditures into stable returns are likely to be the most capable of accelerating expansion, while those lacking fundraising and investment‑recovery capacity may be forced to slow down even amid strong AI demand.

items.title: 水泥雙雄9月營收繳雙增 同步創近21個月新高
items.title_en: Cement Giants Post Dual Revenue Gains in September, Hitting 21-Month High
paras: 水泥雙雄台泥(1101-TW)、亞泥(1102-TW)今(12)日公告9月營收，同步創下2025年1月以來、近21個月新高。台泥營收143.21億元，月增6%、年增7.63%；亞泥營收67.19億元，月增20.2%、年增5.2%。累計前9月，台泥營收1,130.05億元，年增3.3%；亞泥營收504.14億元，年減5.2%。

台泥表示，9月營收成長主要受惠土耳其及葡萄牙水泥業務，反映近年跨歐亞非布局的效益逐步顯現。水泥事業9月營收較去年同期增加9.21億元，累計前9月增加19.82億元。其中，土耳其子公司OYAK Cimento第三季量價齊揚，9月營收年增5.65億元，前9月年增19.17億元；葡萄牙子公司Cimpor則受惠當地水泥售價上升，9月營收年增1.1億元，前9月年增25.21億元，成為水泥事業成長的重要動能。
中國大陸市場方面，台泥指出，第三季水泥需求微幅回升，但價格仍處低檔，9月銷量較去年同期增加、售價大致持平，帶動當月營收成長。台灣市場則受到房貸限縮及房市管制政策影響，營建需求持續放緩，加上低價進口水泥競爭，整體經營環境仍具挑戰，但公司持續維持產品合理售價及價值，9月台灣水泥及預拌混凝土售價均較去年同期上升，價格呈現逐步回穩趨勢。
能源事業方面，台泥旗下鋰電池出貨量維持穩定，營收呈現雙位數成長；義大利儲能公司NHOA則受惠前三季儲能工程案件量增加，帶動累計營收成長。
亞泥9月營收則受惠兩岸市場成長及多元事業挹注，單月營收較去年同期增加5.2%。其中，台灣市場營收月增22%，主要受惠混凝土銷量增加及投資收益挹注；大陸市場營收月增17%，則由水泥銷量與售價同步回升帶動。若與去年同期相比，亞泥9月台灣市場營收年增7%，主要由電力事業穩定成長支撐；大陸市場營收年增1%，整體表現持穩。
不過，累計前9月台灣營收年減5%，受到水泥、混凝土及不鏽鋼量價變化影響；大陸營收年減7%，主要因水泥售價及銷量較去年同期下滑，反映市場仍處於調整期。展望後市，亞泥表示，面對市場供需變化與低碳轉型趨勢，將持續關注市場走勢、深化低碳建材布局，並發揮多元事業與轉投資效益，穩健因應市場挑戰。
paras_en: Cement giants Taiwan Cement (1101-TW) and Asia Cement (1102-TW) announced their September revenues today (the 12th), both reaching the highest levels since January 2025 – a near 21‑month peak. Taiwan Cement posted revenue of NT$14.321 billion, up 6% month‑on‑month and 7.63% year‑on‑year; Asia Cement reported NT$6.719 billion, up 20.2% month‑on‑month and 5.2% year‑on‑year. For the first nine months, Taiwan Cement’s cumulative revenue was NT$113.005 billion, a 3.3% increase year‑on‑year, while Asia Cement’s cumulative revenue was NT$50.414 billion, down 5.2% year‑on‑year.

Taiwan Cement said the September revenue growth was mainly driven by its cement operations in Turkey and Portugal, reflecting the gradual payoff of its cross‑Eurasian‑African expansion. Cement segment revenue in September was NT$9.221 billion higher than a year ago, adding NT$19.82 billion for the first nine months. In Turkey, its subsidiary OYAK Cimento saw both volume and price rise in Q3, delivering a year‑on‑year revenue increase of NT$5.65 billion for September and NT$19.17 billion for the first nine months. In Portugal, subsidiary Cimpor benefited from higher local cement prices, adding NT$1.1 billion in September and NT$25.21 billion for the first nine months, becoming a key growth engine for the cement business.

Regarding the mainland China market, Taiwan Cement noted that cement demand in Q3 rebounded slightly, but prices remained low. September sales volume was higher than a year ago while prices were roughly flat, supporting the month’s revenue growth. In Taiwan, tighter mortgage limits and housing‑market regulations have continued to dampen construction demand, and low‑priced imported cement adds competitive pressure, keeping the overall operating environment challenging. Nevertheless, the company has maintained reasonable product pricing and value; both cement and ready‑mix concrete prices in Taiwan were higher in September than a year ago, showing a gradual price‑stabilisation trend.

In its energy business, Taiwan Cement’s lithium‑battery shipments remained stable, delivering double‑digit revenue growth, while its Italian energy‑storage subsidiary NHOA benefited from a rise in storage‑project volume during the first three quarters, boosting cumulative revenue.

Asia Cement’s September revenue was buoyed by growth in both cross‑strait markets and its diversified businesses, with the single‑month figure up 5.2% year‑on‑year. Revenue in Taiwan rose 22% month‑on‑month, driven by higher concrete sales and investment income; mainland China revenue grew 17% month‑on‑month, supported by simultaneous rebounds in cement volume and price. Compared with the same month last year, Asia Cement’s Taiwan revenue was up 7% year‑on‑year, mainly due to steady growth in its power business, while mainland China revenue was up 1% year‑on‑year, indicating stable overall performance.

However, cumulative revenue for the first nine months fell 5% year‑on‑year in Taiwan, affected by changes in volume and price of cement, concrete and stainless steel, and fell 7% year‑on‑year in mainland China, mainly due to lower cement prices and volumes versus a year ago, reflecting a market still in adjustment. Looking ahead, Asia Cement said it will continue to monitor market dynamics and the low‑carbon transition, deepen its low‑carbon building‑materials portfolio, and leverage its diversified businesses and strategic investments to navigate market challenges steadily.

items.title: 〈台塑四寶業績〉Q4受惠需求旺季、電子業績攀升 兩公司看好業績優於Q3
items.title_en: Formosa Plastics Four-Product Performance: Q4 Benefits from Seasonal Demand Surge and Rising Electronics Sales; Both Companies Expect Better Results Than Q3
paras: 台塑集團今(12)日自結前3季財報及展望說明，今年第4季包括台塑(1301-TW)、南亞(1303-TW)皆估業績會比第3季成長。南亞指出，主要隨高階電子材料認證完成、陸續進入量產，第4季將優於第3季，如今年初預期，仍受惠應用在電子科技領域的各項電子材料需求攀升，強調「今年是亮麗的一年，但明年會更好」。
台塑表示，在石化產品供需上，第4季為石化傳統需求旺季，有利產品銷售，加上感恩、聖誕節及中國網路購物節等各種民生消費產品需求，且第4季為PE/PP包裝材、LLDPE農膜、EVA鞋材、PP玩具及家電用品等旺季，加上中國持續推出房地產等刺激內需政策、印度雨季結束，PVC管建材、AE膠帶及塗料需求增加，有利於產品銷售。
此外，隨美伊戰事反覆，原油及乙、丙烯價格高檔震盪，支撐近期石化產品價格，台塑開工率及產銷第4季較前季提高，估第4季營業額為季增。
南亞則在第4季因電子材料市況仍處供應緊缺、短期內產能增加有限，價格大漲及業界材料規格快速升級的大環境，能快速滿足客戶需求的研發與材料的料源掌握度，成為搶占供應鏈的關鍵能力。
南亞強調，第4季起高階材料處於出貨與驗証併行，已看到明(2027)年在高階先進材料布局，逐漸認證完成量產，電子材料營運大幅提升，出貨量可望大幅提升，將藉由產線優化及重啟等措施，短期內再增加產出量，充份利用產能優勢，滿足內部垂直整合，可穩定供貨下游客戶。
台化(1326-TW)展望第4季，預期美伊可能持續發生衝突，油價將於每桶90美元震盪，不過受權益法投資仍有助獲利，在純苯、對二甲苯及PTA預期第4季供應仍偏緊；塑膠方面，受節慶拉貨需求可期，營運情況應會改善。
台化指出，預期第4季經營狀況比第3季改善，但油價仍是最大變數，但權益法投資收入有望持續挹注營收。
針對未來油價走勢，台塑化(6505-TW)點出，上(9)月美軍持續在荷姆茲海峽護航原油船隊，致美伊兩國的軍事衝突風險持續增加，加上市場認為伊朗將利用各種軍事手段影響中東原油出口，預期荷姆茲海峽難以維持大量原油出口，將持續支撐油價。
此外，雖進入美國汽油需求淡季，但亞洲汽油價差將大幅高於過往冬季水準，在柴油、汽油雙重利差支撐下，有助於煉製毛利在第4季維持強勁。
paras_en: Formosa Plastics Group today (the 12th) released its financial results and outlook for the first three quarters, stating that both Formosa Plastics (1301‑TW) and Nan Ya (1303‑TW) expect fourth‑quarter earnings to grow versus the third quarter. Nan Ya noted that, with the completion of high‑end electronic material certifications and the gradual start of mass production, Q4 will outperform Q3, as anticipated earlier this year, continuing to benefit from rising demand for electronic materials used in the tech sector. It emphasized, “This year has been a brilliant one, and next year will be even better.”

Formosa Plastics said that, on the petrochemical side, the fourth quarter is the traditional peak season for demand, which should boost product sales. In addition, consumer‑driven demand from Thanksgiving, Christmas and China’s online shopping festivals, as well as seasonal peaks for PE/PP packaging, LLDPE agricultural film, EVA shoe material, PP toys and home‑appliance goods, will support sales. Ongoing Chinese stimulus policies for real estate and the end of India’s monsoon season are also increasing demand for PVC pipe building materials, AE tape and coatings, further aiding sales.

Moreover, with the ongoing US‑Iran conflict causing crude oil and ethylene/propylene prices to remain high, recent petrochemical product prices have been supported. Formosa’s operating rates and production‑sales volumes in Q4 are expected to be higher than the previous quarter, and it estimates a sequential increase in Q4 revenue.

Nan Ya explained that, in Q4, the electronic materials market remains tight with limited short‑term capacity expansion, leading to sharp price increases and rapid upgrades in material specifications across the industry. The ability to quickly meet customer needs through strong R&D and secure material sourcing is a key competitive advantage in the supply chain.

Nan Ya emphasized that, starting in Q4, high‑end materials are being shipped and validated simultaneously. It has already seen the layout for advanced high‑end materials in 2027, with certifications progressing toward mass production. Operations in electronic materials are expected to improve dramatically, with shipments rising sharply. By optimizing production lines and restarting facilities, the company plans to increase output in the short term, fully leverage its capacity advantage, satisfy internal vertical integration, and ensure stable supply to downstream customers.

Formosa Chemical (1326‑TW) forecasted that, in Q4, the US‑Iran conflict may continue, keeping oil prices volatile around $90 per barrel. Nevertheless, equity‑method investments should still contribute to earnings, and supplies of pure benzene, p‑xylene and PTA are expected to remain tight in Q4. In the plastics segment, festive‑season demand for inventory pulls is expected, which should improve operating conditions.

Formosa Chemical noted that it expects its Q4 operating performance to improve over Q3, though oil price remains the biggest variable. Equity‑method investment income is expected to continue bolstering revenue.

Regarding future oil‑price trends, Formosa Petrochemical (6505‑TW) pointed out that, in September, US naval forces continued escorting oil tankers through the Hormuz Strait, raising the risk of US‑Iran military clashes. Markets also believe Iran may use various military means to affect Middle‑East oil exports, making it unlikely that the Hormuz Strait will sustain large‑scale oil flows, which should keep oil prices supported.

Additionally, although the United States is entering a gasoline‑demand off‑season, Asian gasoline price differentials are expected to be far higher than in previous winters. The combined spread between diesel and gasoline should help maintain strong refining margins in Q4.

items.title: 淡季不淡！中國動力煤現貨價突破千元大關 創3年新高
items.title_en: Off‑Season Boom: China's Power‑Coal Spot Price Breaks the 1,000‑Yuan Mark, Hits a Three‑Year High
paras: 在傳統用煤淡季的10月，中國國內動力煤(發電用煤)市場走出一波強勁牛市行情。截至10月10日，秦皇島港5500大卡山西產動力煤平倉價達每噸1,003元人民幣，正式升破千元關卡，較去年同期的700元/噸大幅成長逾40%，創下近3年新高。
儘管近年再生能源快速發展，煤炭仍占中國發電結構約五成，此波價格急升已引發市場高度關注。
「供給端緊縮」與「需求端成長」是推升本輪煤價衝高的核心誘因。其中，山西省5月發生致命礦難後，主管機關實施嚴格的安全監管政策，導致今年前8個月中國煤炭產量年減逾3%。雖然官方推動穩產保供，但主產區復產審批進度落後預期。此外，主要鐵路運輸通道「大秦線」10月展開為期三周的檢修，限制了北方港口的補庫速度，截至9月30日的北方港口庫存已降至2,207萬噸。
海外方面，主要進口國印尼因自主減產以及聖嬰現象引發乾旱、影響河道運煤，導致出口量驟降；加上美伊戰爭推高全球能源價格，替代燃料液化天然氣(LNG)價格暴漲，進一步加劇供給緊繃。
此外，受氣溫回升與水力發電出力下滑影響，火力發電負荷顯著增加。2026年8月中國全社會用電量突破1兆度(1,0332億千瓦時)，用電負荷創下15.6億千瓦的歷史新高。隨著秋冬用煤旺季即將到來，電廠與非電產業的剛性採購為煤價提供強烈支撐。
期貨機構分析指出，主產區安檢與運輸限制短期內仍將為煤價提供支撐。然而，下游電廠對高價煤接受度有限，節後需求亦可能隨淡季轉弱。預估短期內煤價將維持高檔震盪與多空博弈格局，後續需持續觀察煤礦復產進度、港口庫存變化及冬季氣溫走勢。
paras_en: In the traditionally low‑demand coal season of October, China’s domestic power‑coal (electricity‑generation coal) market has launched a strong bull run. As of October 10, the settlement price for 5,500‑kcal Shanxi‑origin power coal at Qinhuangdao Port reached 1,003 yuan per tonne, officially breaking the 1,000‑yuan threshold and up more than 40% from the roughly 700 yuan/ton level a year earlier, marking a near‑three‑year high.
Even though renewable energy has expanded rapidly in recent years, coal still accounts for about half of China’s power generation mix, and this sharp price surge has drawn intense market attention.

“Supply tightening” and “demand growth” are the core drivers behind the current price rally. After a fatal mine accident in Shanxi Province in May, regulators imposed strict safety oversight, causing coal output in China to fall by over 3% year‑on‑year in the first eight months. While authorities are pushing for stable production and supply, the approval process for restarting mines in the main producing regions is lagging behind expectations. In addition, the major railway corridor “Da Qin Line” began a three‑week maintenance in October, slowing the replenishment speed of northern ports; by September 30, inventories at northern ports had dropped to 22.07 million tonnes.

On the overseas side, Indonesia—the main supplier—has sharply cut exports due to self‑imposed production cuts and El Niño‑induced droughts that disrupt river transport of coal. Coupled with the US‑Iran conflict driving up global energy prices and the soaring cost of the substitute fuel liquefied natural gas (LNG), supply tightness has been further exacerbated.

Moreover, rising temperatures and a decline in hydro‑electric output have significantly increased thermal‑generation load. In August 2026, China’s total electricity consumption surpassed 1 terawatt‑hour (10,332 billion kWh), with power‑load reaching a historic 15.6 billion kilowatts. As the autumn‑winter coal‑demand season approaches, the rigid purchasing needs of power plants and non‑power industries provide strong support for coal prices.

Futures analysts note that safety inspections in the main producing areas and transport constraints will continue to underpin coal prices in the short term. However, downstream power plants have limited tolerance for high‑priced coal, and post‑holiday demand may weaken as the season turns low. They forecast that coal prices will remain in a high‑level, volatile “bull‑bear” range in the near term, with ongoing attention needed on mine‑restart progress, port inventory changes, and winter temperature trends.

items.title: 記憶體缺貨持續影響筆電客戶拉貨 圓裕9月營收探7個月來低點
items.title_en: Memory Shortage Continues to Impact Laptop Customers' Orders, Yuan Yu's September Revenue Hits 7-Month Low
paras: 軟板廠圓裕（6835-TW）今（12）日公告9月營收1.63億元，探7個月來新低，月減2.98%、年減15.43%；第三季營收5.44億元，季減8.93%、年減10.77%；累計前9月營收17.18億元，年減7.52%。圓裕表示，全年營收力拚與2025年持平。
圓裕應用於商務型筆電及消費型筆電的產品，受到記憶體與CPU缺貨影響，客戶拉貨動能減弱，營收表現因此不及去年同期。面對記憶體缺貨的影響，圓裕積極拓展消費性電子應用產品，並調整產品組合，以降低記憶體缺貨帶來的風險。隨著記憶體缺貨情況可望逐漸緩解，加上消費性電子產品出貨穩定，圓裕全年營收力拚與去年持平。
圓裕指出，AI帶動電子產品升級換代，儘管記憶體漲價引發消費市場觀望，各大筆電客戶目前仍積極開發多款新機種，以迎接筆電換機潮。圓裕已配合多家客戶送樣新機種產品，布局筆電換機潮商機。
圓裕表示，隨著AI應用日益廣泛，消費性電子產品市場也持續擴大，今年以來，公司消費性電子產品業務穩定成長。消費性電子產品應用相當多元，圓裕與國際EMS大廠客戶長期配合，具備高度客製化及交期彈性的優勢，有利於公司爭取更多元的訂單。
paras_en: Flexible circuit manufacturer Yuan Yu (6835‑TW) announced today (12th) that its September revenue was NT$163 million, reaching a seven‑month low, down 2.98% month‑over‑month and 15.43% year‑over‑year. Third‑quarter revenue was NT$544 million, down 8.93% quarter‑over‑quarter and 10.77% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first nine months was NT$1.718 billion, a 7.52% decline from a year ago. Yuan Yu said it will strive to keep full‑year revenue on par with 2025 levels.

Yuan Yu's products for business‑grade and consumer‑grade laptops were affected by shortages of memory and CPUs, weakening customers' pull‑forward orders and causing revenue to fall short of the same period last year. In response to the memory shortage, Yuan Yu is actively expanding into consumer electronics applications and adjusting its product mix to reduce the risk from memory scarcity. As the memory shortage is expected to ease gradually and shipments of consumer electronics remain stable, Yuan Yu aims to keep its full‑year revenue level comparable to last year.

Yuan Yu noted that AI is driving upgrades of electronic products. Although rising memory prices have made the consumer market cautious, major laptop manufacturers are still actively developing multiple new models to meet the upcoming laptop replacement wave. Yuan Yu has already supplied sample new‑model products to several customers, positioning itself to capture the laptop upgrade opportunity.

Yuan Yu said that as AI applications become more widespread, the consumer electronics market continues to expand, and the company's consumer electronics business has shown steady growth this year. Consumer electronics applications are highly diverse; Yuan Yu works long‑term with major international EMS customers, offering high customization and flexible delivery schedules, which helps the company win a broader range of orders.

items.title: 年底還能再漲一波？標普500企業獲利估增25% 全球股市等財報拿出真本事
items.title_en: Can the Market Still Rally at Year‑End? S&P 500 Earnings Expected to Grow 25% as Global Stocks Await Strong Reports
paras: 全球股市想在年底再衝一波，企業財報得先拿出真本事。通膨疑慮再起、債市波動加劇，加上人工智慧(AI)支出引發疑慮，讓股市漲勢陷入停頓。在歐美股市仍接近歷史高點之際，即將登場的第三季財報，不僅要交出獲利成長，更得證明高估值與後續漲勢有基本面支撐。
據《彭博》報導，摩根大通(JPM-US)、高盛(GS-US)等美國大型銀行將於周二揭開財報季序幕。彭博行業研究(BI)彙整資料顯示，標普500指數成分企業第三季獲利預估年增25%；花旗(C-US)模型則預測，本季美國企業獲利優於預期的比例將高於上一季，以科技、醫療保健及礦業表現領先。
Leverage Shares資深研究分析師Violeta Todorova表示，這次財報季未必決定股市成敗，卻是企業必須「拿出證據」的時刻，因為市場已拉高標準，漲勢需要進一步確認。過去企業往往只須跨過下修後的門檻，這次卻得跳過更高的標竿。
MSCI全球股票指數自8月中旬創下新高後便陷入停滯，分析師卻持續上修獲利預估，使估值降至平均水準以下。不過，投資人仍擔心消費支出放緩，最終拖累整體經濟成長。

AI財報門檻愈墊愈高 獲利成長須擴及其他產業

AI仍是本季財報焦點。BI資料顯示，美國AI相關企業第三季獲利預估年增47%，成長幅度僅次於能源業；資訊科技業今年預料將貢獻標普500企業整體獲利的三分之一。亞洲方面，受惠於AI需求，台灣與南韓企業預期將帶動區域獲利成長66%。
然而，MSCI全球資訊科技指數今年已上漲31%，並攀上歷史新高，意味企業必須交出更亮眼的成績，才能推動股價續漲。Roundhill Financial執行長Dave Mazza表示，單純繳出優於預期的財報並上調展望，已被市場視為理所當然；企業還得提高全年財測，並證明能維持獲利率。
美光(MU-US)本月稍早公布的業績優於預期，也指出AI相關需求具有持續性，市場反應卻平淡。三星電子(005930-KR)上季營業利益增至接近去年同期的9倍，股價上周仍下跌2.4%，凸顯市場對AI受惠企業的要求愈來愈高。
Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)、Meta(META-US)及甲骨文(ORCL-US)等大型雲端業者持續投資資料中心，也提振電網營運商與基礎建設供應商的展望。不過，隨著公債殖利率急升，企業籌資步調令投資人不安。SpaceX(SPCX-US)的一項信用風險指標上周升至新高，其債券在次級市場的價格也走弱。
除了科技業，投資人也希望消費、工業及銀行等景氣敏感產業能加入獲利成長行列。CG Asset Management投資組合經理Emma Moriarty表示，非科技產業的財報有助判斷整體經濟狀況，也能觀察是否出現AI及相關服務表現強勁、其他產業相對疲弱的兩樣情。
摩根士丹利(MS-US)策略師Michael Wilson指出，羅素3000指數成分股獲利成長率的中位數，2026年可望達14%，顯示基本面仍強健。其中，工業類股獲利預估持續獲得上修，估值則較夏季回落；獲利品質、自由現金流，以及獲利預估上修是否擴及更多企業，將成為區分表現的關鍵。

歐亞股市各有優勢 消費疲弱仍是共同考驗

歐洲市場提供不同於美國科技股的投資選擇。高盛追蹤的一籃子歐洲資本密集型股票，表現優於較依賴人力或數位資產的輕資產產業。這類被稱為HALO，即「重資產、低淘汰風險」的股票，涵蓋公用事業及能源等產業，被視為較不易受到AI相關波動衝擊。
RootBridge Capital管理合夥人Alpesh Patel表示，歐洲的優勢在於價格，以及不同的獲利來源。科技股僅占道瓊歐洲600指數約10%，若龐大的AI資本支出開始形成負擔，這樣的產業結構可提供部分避險效果。
亞洲方面，MSCI亞太指數今年表現優於標普500及道瓊歐洲600指數，但投資人同樣希望確認，獲利成長能否從深度參與AI供應鏈的科技業，擴散至其他產業。
消費正是主要考驗之一。能源價格上漲推高燃料成本，公債殖利率攀升則推升房貸、車貸及信用卡利率，壓縮家庭購買力，也使消費相關產業成為今年表現最落後的族群之一。
初步財報訊號並不亮眼。好市多(COST-US)單季獲利雖優於預期，付費會員人數增幅卻不如市場預估。瑞典服飾零售商H&M(瑞典股市代號HM B)也因分析師指出，剔除美國關稅退款效益後，獲利率明顯下滑，股價因而走低。
中國消費企業則在缺乏大規模刺激措施之下，持續面臨支出低迷與信心脆弱的壓力。eToro(ETOR-US)亞太首席分析師Josh Gilbert表示，最佳進場時點往往出現在展望仍黯淡之際，但目前油價與利率仍朝不利方向變動，亞洲消費股的布局時機似乎尚未到來。

高利率從助力變壓力 銀行財報聚焦放款與信用品質

銀行股今年稍早受惠於殖利率上升，市場看好放款利差擴大；但隨著利率持續攀升，投資人開始更關注信用品質、放款成長與資本市場業務能否承受壓力。
歐洲銀行業還面臨法國財政疑慮衝擊。原本是區域表現最佳類股之一的道瓊歐洲600銀行指數，過去兩周已下跌約8%。
摩根大通私人銀行歐洲、中東及非洲股票策略主管Nataliia Lipikhina表示，市場將檢視銀行放款成長是否依然強勁；不過，就投資組合配置而言，團隊仍偏好將新增資金投入美國或新興市場。
摩根大通上周也轉而對東南亞銀行業抱持審慎態度，警告長天期公債殖利率急升，可能導致按市價評價損失，並壓抑資本市場業務收入。分析師Harsh Wardhan Modi指出，旗下追蹤的多家銀行在2026年第三季較可能出現負面意外，因此建議客戶降低配置。
paras_en: Global equity markets hope to push higher before year‑end, but corporate earnings must deliver. Renewed inflation worries, heightened bond‑market volatility, and concerns over AI spending have stalled the rally. As U.S. and European markets linger near historic highs, the upcoming Q3 earnings season must not only show profit growth but also prove that lofty valuations and further upside have fundamental support.

Bloomberg reports that major U.S. banks such as JPMorgan (JPM‑US) and Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) will kick off earnings season on Tuesday. Bloomberg Intelligence data show that S&P 500 constituents are projected to post a 25% year‑over‑year profit increase for Q3, while Citi’s (C‑US) model expects the proportion of U.S. companies beating earnings expectations this quarter to exceed the prior quarter, led by technology, healthcare and mining sectors.

Leverage Shares senior analyst Violeta Todorova says this earnings season may not decide the market’s fate, but it is the moment for companies to “show the evidence” because the market’s baseline has been raised and any rally needs further confirmation. In the past firms only had to clear a lowered hurdle after cuts; this time they must clear a higher bar.

Since mid‑August the MSCI World Index has stalled after hitting a fresh high, yet analysts keep lifting profit forecasts, pulling valuations below average levels. Nevertheless, investors remain uneasy about slowing consumer spending, which could ultimately drag down overall economic growth.

AI remains the focal point of this quarter’s reports. Bloomberg Intelligence data indicate that U.S. AI‑related firms are expected to see a 47% year‑over‑year profit rise in Q3, second only to energy. The information‑technology sector is slated to contribute about one‑third of total S&P 500 earnings this year. In Asia, AI demand is expected to lift Taiwanese and South Korean companies’ regional profit growth by 66%.

However, the MSCI World Information‑Technology Index is already up 31% this year and has reached a historic peak, meaning firms must deliver even brighter results to keep stock prices climbing. Roundhill Financial CEO Dave Mazza notes that simply beating expectations and raising guidance is now taken for granted; companies must also lift full‑year forecasts and prove they can sustain profit margins.

Micron (MU‑US) posted better‑than‑expected results earlier this month and highlighted the durability of AI‑related demand, yet the market reaction was muted. Samsung Electronics (005930‑KR) saw operating profit rise to nearly nine times its level a year ago, but its share price fell 2.4% last week, underscoring the growing scrutiny on AI‑benefiting firms.

Big cloud players such as Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Meta (META‑US) and Oracle (ORCL‑US) continue to invest in data centers, boosting outlooks for power‑grid operators and infrastructure suppliers. Yet soaring sovereign‑bond yields have made corporate financing pace a source of investor anxiety. SpaceX’s (SPCX‑US) credit‑risk indicator spiked to a new high last week, and its bonds weakened in the secondary market.

Beyond tech, investors hope that consumer, industrial and banking sectors—traditionally sensitive to the business cycle—will also join the profit‑growth story. CG Asset Management portfolio manager Emma Moriarty says non‑tech earnings help gauge the broader economy and reveal whether AI and related services are strong while other industries lag.

Morgan Stanley (MS‑US) strategist Michael Wilson points out that the median profit‑growth rate for Russell 3000 constituents could reach 14% by 2026, indicating robust fundamentals. Industrial stocks continue to receive profit‑forecast upgrades, with valuations retreating from summer peaks; the quality of earnings, free‑cash‑flow generation and the breadth of profit‑forecast revisions will be key performance differentiators.

European and Asian markets each have their own strengths, but weak consumer demand remains a shared challenge. Europe offers investment options distinct from U.S. tech stocks. Goldman Sachs tracks a basket of European capital‑intensive equities that outperforms lighter‑asset sectors reliant on labor or digital assets. These “HALO” stocks—heavy‑asset, low‑obsolescence names such as utilities and energy—are seen as less vulnerable to AI‑related volatility.

RootBridge Capital partner Alpesh Patel says Europe’s advantage lies in pricing and diversified profit sources. Technology makes up only about 10% of the Dow Jones Europe 600, so if massive AI capex becomes a burden, this sector composition can provide a partial hedge.

In Asia, the MSCI Asia‑Pacific Index has outperformed both the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Europe 600 this year, but investors still want confirmation that profit growth can spread from AI‑heavy tech firms to other industries.

Consumer spending is a primary test. Rising energy prices lift fuel costs, while higher sovereign yields push up mortgage, auto‑loan and credit‑card rates, squeezing household purchasing power and making consumer‑related sectors among the weakest performers this year.

Early earnings signals are underwhelming. Costco (COST‑US) posted quarterly profit above forecasts, yet membership growth lagged expectations. Swedish apparel retailer H&M (HM B) saw its profit margin tumble once analysts stripped out the benefit of U.S. tariff refunds, sending the stock lower.

Chinese consumer firms continue to face weak spending and fragile confidence without large‑scale stimulus. eToro (ETOR‑US) Asia‑Pacific chief analyst Josh Gilbert notes that the best entry points often appear when outlooks are bleak, but with oil prices and rates moving unfavorably, the timing for Asian consumer stocks still seems premature.

High rates have shifted from a tailwind to a drag, focusing bank earnings on loan growth and credit quality. Earlier this year banks benefited from rising yields and widening loan spreads, but as rates keep climbing investors are scrutinizing credit quality, loan‑book expansion and capital‑market resilience.
European banks also grapple with fiscal concerns in France. The Dow Jones Europe 600 banking index, once a top regional performer, has fallen about 8% over the past two weeks.

JPMorgan private‑bank Europe, Middle East and Africa equities strategy head Nataliia Lipikhina says the market will watch whether bank loan growth remains robust; however, in terms of portfolio allocation the team still prefers directing new capital to the U.S. or emerging markets.

JPMorgan last week turned more cautious on Southeast Asian banks, warning that sharply rising long‑term sovereign yields could trigger mark‑to‑market losses and suppress capital‑market revenue. Analyst Harsh Wardhan Modi notes that several of the firm’s tracked banks could face adverse events in Q3 2026, prompting a recommendation to reduce exposure.

items.title: 〈電信三雄財報〉中華電信資通訊業務動能強勁 9月EPS 0.57元續坐獲利王寶座
paras: 電信三雄今(12)日公告最新營收，中華電信(2412-TW)資通訊業務動能維持強勁，相關營收年增逾2成，帶動9月稅後純益達44.4億元，每股純益0.57元，高於台灣大(3045-TW)的0.48元，以及遠傳(4904-TW)的0.36元。

中華電信 

中華電信9月營收244億元，月增4.68%，年增20.85%；EBITDA 87.4億元，季減3.43%，年增20.89%；稅後純益44.4億元，月對月持平，年增44.16%，每股純益0.57元。
中華電信累計今年前三季營收1889.5億元，年增10.85%；EBITDA 724.8億元，年增7.83%；稅後純益329.7億元，年增12.1%，每股純益4.25元。
中華電信9月營收受惠一次性資產活化效益，加上資通訊業務成長動能不墜，以及電信核心業務穩健，帶動營收創歷史同期新高。另外，蘋果(AAPL-US)新機上市，推升行動客戶數與ARPU成長、手機及3C銷貨收入增加，子公司因AI需求成長也挹注銷貨收入，都是9月營收亮眼因素。
中華電信表示，9月資通訊營收較去年同期成長24.9%，主要受惠金融服務與監管部門對IDC、雲端服務及資安設備建置需求持續擴張，帶動IDC及雲端與資安相關營收高速成長。
此外，海外子公司台商建廠專案完工交付，進一步推升資通訊專案營收，反應海內外企業的數位轉型及AI應用需求不斷增溫，預期將持續帶動中華電信成長。
電信核心業務方面，行動業務受惠5G升速方案持續熱銷、客戶數穩健成長，加上漫遊需求較去年同期增溫，帶動9月行動服務營收年增3.2%。固網寬頻業務則隨AI與數位應用帶動高速頻寬需求增加，9月300Mbps以上高速寬頻用戶數年增14.4%，帶動固網寬頻營收年增3%，其中，1Gbps以上高速率用戶數較去年同期成長逾6成。

台灣大 

台灣大9月營收174.1億元，月增3.75%，年增10.33%；EBITDA 37.32億元，月減2.99%，年增6.93%；稅後純益14.7億元，月增5.76%，年增28.95%，每股純益0.48元。
台灣大第三季營收503.6億元，季增1.88%，年增8.68%；EBITDA 113.14億元，季減1.59%，年增6.45%；稅後純益42.7億元，季減6.15%，年增18.61%，每股純益1.4元。
台灣大累計今年前三季營收1495.8億元，年增5.36%；EBITDA 341.65億元，年增7.53%；稅後純益129.5億元，年增22.87%，每股純益4.26元。
台灣大指出，受惠iPhone換機熱潮與企業電信事業驅動下全速運轉，推升9月營收年增逾1成。
Telco電信本業方面，iPhone 18 Pro系列開賣帶動買氣，申辦用戶中逾7成選擇搭配月租1399元以上高資費方案，帶動單月銷貨收入年增20%，另一方面，受惠於全光速等高速家用寬頻服務驅動，家戶事業營收也年增15%；Telco+企業事業方面，受惠AIDC收入挹注，單月營收年增幅顯著跳升。
Telco+Tech科技事業方面，momo營收年增8%，增幅續創今年新高，品牌電商受惠新代理品牌3COINS首店開幕，成長動能進一步提升。
遠傳累計今年前三季營收862.3億元，年增11.04%；EBITDA 303.18億元，年增7.28%；稅後純益113.92億元，年增13.24%，每股純益3.16元。
遠傳指出，受惠電信本業、個人數位生活及智慧資通訊三大成長引擎穩健發展，各項財務指標均優於年度財測目標，第三季EPS達成率達105%，前三季EPS達成率更達110%。
遠傳電信本業穩健成長，9月總用戶數持續擴大。月租型用戶5G滲透率突破5成大關，與4G用戶數達成黃金交叉。隨著iPhone新機買氣帶動5G升級潮，月租型用戶每月平均貢獻度(ARPU)穩定向上，推升行動服務營收達53.39億元。
遠傳企業智慧資通訊維持良好成長動能，9月受惠雲端專案順利交付，相關業務營收持續增溫。此外，為協助企業加速數位轉型與AI應用落地，遠傳成為全台首家取得GitHub AI開發顧問資格的企業，並將成立「遠傳AI開發顧問團隊」。

items.title: 水泥雙雄9月營收繳雙增 同步創近21個月新高
items.title_en: Cement Giants Post Dual Revenue Gains in September, Hitting 21-Month High
paras: 水泥雙雄台泥(1101-TW)、亞泥(1102-TW)今(12)日公告9月營收，同步創下2025年1月以來、近21個月新高。台泥營收143.21億元，月增6%、年增7.63%；亞泥營收67.19億元，月增20.2%、年增5.2%。累計前9月，台泥營收1,130.05億元，年增3.3%；亞泥營收504.14億元，年減5.2%。

台泥表示，9月營收成長主要受惠土耳其及葡萄牙水泥業務，反映近年跨歐亞非布局的效益逐步顯現。水泥事業9月營收較去年同期增加9.21億元，累計前9月增加19.82億元。其中，土耳其子公司OYAK Cimento第三季量價齊揚，9月營收年增5.65億元，前9月年增19.17億元；葡萄牙子公司Cimpor則受惠當地水泥售價上升，9月營收年增1.1億元，前9月年增25.21億元，成為水泥事業成長的重要動能。
中國大陸市場方面，台泥指出，第三季水泥需求微幅回升，但價格仍處低檔，9月銷量較去年同期增加、售價大致持平，帶動當月營收成長。台灣市場則受到房貸限縮及房市管制政策影響，營建需求持續放緩，加上低價進口水泥競爭，整體經營環境仍具挑戰，但公司持續維持產品合理售價及價值，9月台灣水泥及預拌混凝土售價均較去年同期上升，價格呈現逐步回穩趨勢。
能源事業方面，台泥旗下鋰電池出貨量維持穩定，營收呈現雙位數成長；義大利儲能公司NHOA則受惠前三季儲能工程案件量增加，帶動累計營收成長。
亞泥9月營收則受惠兩岸市場成長及多元事業挹注，單月營收較去年同期增加5.2%。其中，台灣市場營收月增22%，主要受惠混凝土銷量增加及投資收益挹注；大陸市場營收月增17%，則由水泥銷量與售價同步回升帶動。若與去年同期相比，亞泥9月台灣市場營收年增7%，主要由電力事業穩定成長支撐；大陸市場營收年增1%，整體表現持穩。
不過，累計前9月台灣營收年減5%，受到水泥、混凝土及不鏽鋼量價變化影響；大陸營收年減7%，主要因水泥售價及銷量較去年同期下滑，反映市場仍處於調整期。展望後市，亞泥表示，面對市場供需變化與低碳轉型趨勢，將持續關注市場走勢、深化低碳建材布局，並發揮多元事業與轉投資效益，穩健因應市場挑戰。
paras_en: Cement giants Taiwan Cement (1101-TW) and Asia Cement (1102-TW) announced their September revenues today (the 12th), both reaching the highest levels since January 2025 – a near 21‑month peak. Taiwan Cement posted revenue of NT$14.321 billion, up 6% month‑on‑month and 7.63% year‑on‑year; Asia Cement reported NT$6.719 billion, up 20.2% month‑on‑month and 5.2% year‑on‑year. For the first nine months, Taiwan Cement’s cumulative revenue was NT$113.005 billion, a 3.3% increase year‑on‑year, while Asia Cement’s cumulative revenue was NT$50.414 billion, down 5.2% year‑on‑year.

Taiwan Cement said the September revenue growth was mainly driven by its cement operations in Turkey and Portugal, reflecting the gradual payoff of its cross‑Eurasian‑African expansion. Cement segment revenue in September was NT$9.221 billion higher than a year ago, adding NT$19.82 billion for the first nine months. In Turkey, its subsidiary OYAK Cimento saw both volume and price rise in Q3, delivering a year‑on‑year revenue increase of NT$5.65 billion for September and NT$19.17 billion for the first nine months. In Portugal, subsidiary Cimpor benefited from higher local cement prices, adding NT$1.1 billion in September and NT$25.21 billion for the first nine months, becoming a key growth engine for the cement business.

Regarding the mainland China market, Taiwan Cement noted that cement demand in Q3 rebounded slightly, but prices remained low. September sales volume was higher than a year ago while prices were roughly flat, supporting the month’s revenue growth. In Taiwan, tighter mortgage limits and housing‑market regulations have continued to dampen construction demand, and low‑priced imported cement adds competitive pressure, keeping the overall operating environment challenging. Nevertheless, the company has maintained reasonable product pricing and value; both cement and ready‑mix concrete prices in Taiwan were higher in September than a year ago, showing a gradual price‑stabilisation trend.

In its energy business, Taiwan Cement’s lithium‑battery shipments remained stable, delivering double‑digit revenue growth, while its Italian energy‑storage subsidiary NHOA benefited from a rise in storage‑project volume during the first three quarters, boosting cumulative revenue.

Asia Cement’s September revenue was buoyed by growth in both cross‑strait markets and its diversified businesses, with the single‑month figure up 5.2% year‑on‑year. Revenue in Taiwan rose 22% month‑on‑month, driven by higher concrete sales and investment income; mainland China revenue grew 17% month‑on‑month, supported by simultaneous rebounds in cement volume and price. Compared with the same month last year, Asia Cement’s Taiwan revenue was up 7% year‑on‑year, mainly due to steady growth in its power business, while mainland China revenue was up 1% year‑on‑year, indicating stable overall performance.

However, cumulative revenue for the first nine months fell 5% year‑on‑year in Taiwan, affected by changes in volume and price of cement, concrete and stainless steel, and fell 7% year‑on‑year in mainland China, mainly due to lower cement prices and volumes versus a year ago, reflecting a market still in adjustment. Looking ahead, Asia Cement said it will continue to monitor market dynamics and the low‑carbon transition, deepen its low‑carbon building‑materials portfolio, and leverage its diversified businesses and strategic investments to navigate market challenges steadily.

items.title: 〈台塑四寶業績〉Q4受惠需求旺季、電子業績攀升 兩公司看好業績優於Q3
items.title_en: Formosa Plastics Four-Product Performance: Q4 Benefits from Seasonal Demand Surge and Rising Electronics Sales; Both Companies Expect Better Results Than Q3
paras: 台塑集團今(12)日自結前3季財報及展望說明，今年第4季包括台塑(1301-TW)、南亞(1303-TW)皆估業績會比第3季成長。南亞指出，主要隨高階電子材料認證完成、陸續進入量產，第4季將優於第3季，如今年初預期，仍受惠應用在電子科技領域的各項電子材料需求攀升，強調「今年是亮麗的一年，但明年會更好」。
台塑表示，在石化產品供需上，第4季為石化傳統需求旺季，有利產品銷售，加上感恩、聖誕節及中國網路購物節等各種民生消費產品需求，且第4季為PE/PP包裝材、LLDPE農膜、EVA鞋材、PP玩具及家電用品等旺季，加上中國持續推出房地產等刺激內需政策、印度雨季結束，PVC管建材、AE膠帶及塗料需求增加，有利於產品銷售。
此外，隨美伊戰事反覆，原油及乙、丙烯價格高檔震盪，支撐近期石化產品價格，台塑開工率及產銷第4季較前季提高，估第4季營業額為季增。
南亞則在第4季因電子材料市況仍處供應緊缺、短期內產能增加有限，價格大漲及業界材料規格快速升級的大環境，能快速滿足客戶需求的研發與材料的料源掌握度，成為搶占供應鏈的關鍵能力。
南亞強調，第4季起高階材料處於出貨與驗証併行，已看到明(2027)年在高階先進材料布局，逐漸認證完成量產，電子材料營運大幅提升，出貨量可望大幅提升，將藉由產線優化及重啟等措施，短期內再增加產出量，充份利用產能優勢，滿足內部垂直整合，可穩定供貨下游客戶。
台化(1326-TW)展望第4季，預期美伊可能持續發生衝突，油價將於每桶90美元震盪，不過受權益法投資仍有助獲利，在純苯、對二甲苯及PTA預期第4季供應仍偏緊；塑膠方面，受節慶拉貨需求可期，營運情況應會改善。
台化指出，預期第4季經營狀況比第3季改善，但油價仍是最大變數，但權益法投資收入有望持續挹注營收。
針對未來油價走勢，台塑化(6505-TW)點出，上(9)月美軍持續在荷姆茲海峽護航原油船隊，致美伊兩國的軍事衝突風險持續增加，加上市場認為伊朗將利用各種軍事手段影響中東原油出口，預期荷姆茲海峽難以維持大量原油出口，將持續支撐油價。
此外，雖進入美國汽油需求淡季，但亞洲汽油價差將大幅高於過往冬季水準，在柴油、汽油雙重利差支撐下，有助於煉製毛利在第4季維持強勁。
paras_en: Formosa Plastics Group today (the 12th) released its financial results and outlook for the first three quarters, stating that both Formosa Plastics (1301‑TW) and Nan Ya (1303‑TW) expect fourth‑quarter earnings to grow versus the third quarter. Nan Ya noted that, with the completion of high‑end electronic material certifications and the gradual start of mass production, Q4 will outperform Q3, as anticipated earlier this year, continuing to benefit from rising demand for electronic materials used in the tech sector. It emphasized, “This year has been a brilliant one, and next year will be even better.”

Formosa Plastics said that, on the petrochemical side, the fourth quarter is the traditional peak season for demand, which should boost product sales. In addition, consumer‑driven demand from Thanksgiving, Christmas and China’s online shopping festivals, as well as seasonal peaks for PE/PP packaging, LLDPE agricultural film, EVA shoe material, PP toys and home‑appliance goods, will support sales. Ongoing Chinese stimulus policies for real estate and the end of India’s monsoon season are also increasing demand for PVC pipe building materials, AE tape and coatings, further aiding sales.

Moreover, with the ongoing US‑Iran conflict causing crude oil and ethylene/propylene prices to remain high, recent petrochemical product prices have been supported. Formosa’s operating rates and production‑sales volumes in Q4 are expected to be higher than the previous quarter, and it estimates a sequential increase in Q4 revenue.

Nan Ya explained that, in Q4, the electronic materials market remains tight with limited short‑term capacity expansion, leading to sharp price increases and rapid upgrades in material specifications across the industry. The ability to quickly meet customer needs through strong R&D and secure material sourcing is a key competitive advantage in the supply chain.

Nan Ya emphasized that, starting in Q4, high‑end materials are being shipped and validated simultaneously. It has already seen the layout for advanced high‑end materials in 2027, with certifications progressing toward mass production. Operations in electronic materials are expected to improve dramatically, with shipments rising sharply. By optimizing production lines and restarting facilities, the company plans to increase output in the short term, fully leverage its capacity advantage, satisfy internal vertical integration, and ensure stable supply to downstream customers.

Formosa Chemical (1326‑TW) forecasted that, in Q4, the US‑Iran conflict may continue, keeping oil prices volatile around $90 per barrel. Nevertheless, equity‑method investments should still contribute to earnings, and supplies of pure benzene, p‑xylene and PTA are expected to remain tight in Q4. In the plastics segment, festive‑season demand for inventory pulls is expected, which should improve operating conditions.

Formosa Chemical noted that it expects its Q4 operating performance to improve over Q3, though oil price remains the biggest variable. Equity‑method investment income is expected to continue bolstering revenue.

Regarding future oil‑price trends, Formosa Petrochemical (6505‑TW) pointed out that, in September, US naval forces continued escorting oil tankers through the Hormuz Strait, raising the risk of US‑Iran military clashes. Markets also believe Iran may use various military means to affect Middle‑East oil exports, making it unlikely that the Hormuz Strait will sustain large‑scale oil flows, which should keep oil prices supported.

Additionally, although the United States is entering a gasoline‑demand off‑season, Asian gasoline price differentials are expected to be far higher than in previous winters. The combined spread between diesel and gasoline should help maintain strong refining margins in Q4.

items.title: 記憶體缺貨持續影響筆電客戶拉貨 圓裕9月營收探7個月來低點
items.title_en: Memory Shortage Continues to Impact Laptop Customers' Orders, Yuan Yu's September Revenue Hits 7-Month Low
paras: 軟板廠圓裕（6835-TW）今（12）日公告9月營收1.63億元，探7個月來新低，月減2.98%、年減15.43%；第三季營收5.44億元，季減8.93%、年減10.77%；累計前9月營收17.18億元，年減7.52%。圓裕表示，全年營收力拚與2025年持平。
圓裕應用於商務型筆電及消費型筆電的產品，受到記憶體與CPU缺貨影響，客戶拉貨動能減弱，營收表現因此不及去年同期。面對記憶體缺貨的影響，圓裕積極拓展消費性電子應用產品，並調整產品組合，以降低記憶體缺貨帶來的風險。隨著記憶體缺貨情況可望逐漸緩解，加上消費性電子產品出貨穩定，圓裕全年營收力拚與去年持平。
圓裕指出，AI帶動電子產品升級換代，儘管記憶體漲價引發消費市場觀望，各大筆電客戶目前仍積極開發多款新機種，以迎接筆電換機潮。圓裕已配合多家客戶送樣新機種產品，布局筆電換機潮商機。
圓裕表示，隨著AI應用日益廣泛，消費性電子產品市場也持續擴大，今年以來，公司消費性電子產品業務穩定成長。消費性電子產品應用相當多元，圓裕與國際EMS大廠客戶長期配合，具備高度客製化及交期彈性的優勢，有利於公司爭取更多元的訂單。
paras_en: Flexible circuit manufacturer Yuan Yu (6835‑TW) announced today (12th) that its September revenue was NT$163 million, reaching a seven‑month low, down 2.98% month‑over‑month and 15.43% year‑over‑year. Third‑quarter revenue was NT$544 million, down 8.93% quarter‑over‑quarter and 10.77% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first nine months was NT$1.718 billion, a 7.52% decline from a year ago. Yuan Yu said it will strive to keep full‑year revenue on par with 2025 levels.

Yuan Yu's products for business‑grade and consumer‑grade laptops were affected by shortages of memory and CPUs, weakening customers' pull‑forward orders and causing revenue to fall short of the same period last year. In response to the memory shortage, Yuan Yu is actively expanding into consumer electronics applications and adjusting its product mix to reduce the risk from memory scarcity. As the memory shortage is expected to ease gradually and shipments of consumer electronics remain stable, Yuan Yu aims to keep its full‑year revenue level comparable to last year.

Yuan Yu noted that AI is driving upgrades of electronic products. Although rising memory prices have made the consumer market cautious, major laptop manufacturers are still actively developing multiple new models to meet the upcoming laptop replacement wave. Yuan Yu has already supplied sample new‑model products to several customers, positioning itself to capture the laptop upgrade opportunity.

Yuan Yu said that as AI applications become more widespread, the consumer electronics market continues to expand, and the company's consumer electronics business has shown steady growth this year. Consumer electronics applications are highly diverse; Yuan Yu works long‑term with major international EMS customers, offering high customization and flexible delivery schedules, which helps the company win a broader range of orders.

items.title: 〈電信三雄財報〉中華電信資通訊業務動能強勁 9月EPS 0.57元續坐獲利王寶座
paras: 電信三雄今(12)日公告最新營收，中華電信(2412-TW)資通訊業務動能維持強勁，相關營收年增逾2成，帶動9月稅後純益達44.4億元，每股純益0.57元，高於台灣大(3045-TW)的0.48元，以及遠傳(4904-TW)的0.36元。

中華電信 

中華電信9月營收244億元，月增4.68%，年增20.85%；EBITDA 87.4億元，季減3.43%，年增20.89%；稅後純益44.4億元，月對月持平，年增44.16%，每股純益0.57元。
中華電信累計今年前三季營收1889.5億元，年增10.85%；EBITDA 724.8億元，年增7.83%；稅後純益329.7億元，年增12.1%，每股純益4.25元。
中華電信9月營收受惠一次性資產活化效益，加上資通訊業務成長動能不墜，以及電信核心業務穩健，帶動營收創歷史同期新高。另外，蘋果(AAPL-US)新機上市，推升行動客戶數與ARPU成長、手機及3C銷貨收入增加，子公司因AI需求成長也挹注銷貨收入，都是9月營收亮眼因素。
中華電信表示，9月資通訊營收較去年同期成長24.9%，主要受惠金融服務與監管部門對IDC、雲端服務及資安設備建置需求持續擴張，帶動IDC及雲端與資安相關營收高速成長。
此外，海外子公司台商建廠專案完工交付，進一步推升資通訊專案營收，反應海內外企業的數位轉型及AI應用需求不斷增溫，預期將持續帶動中華電信成長。
電信核心業務方面，行動業務受惠5G升速方案持續熱銷、客戶數穩健成長，加上漫遊需求較去年同期增溫，帶動9月行動服務營收年增3.2%。固網寬頻業務則隨AI與數位應用帶動高速頻寬需求增加，9月300Mbps以上高速寬頻用戶數年增14.4%，帶動固網寬頻營收年增3%，其中，1Gbps以上高速率用戶數較去年同期成長逾6成。

台灣大 

台灣大9月營收174.1億元，月增3.75%，年增10.33%；EBITDA 37.32億元，月減2.99%，年增6.93%；稅後純益14.7億元，月增5.76%，年增28.95%，每股純益0.48元。
台灣大第三季營收503.6億元，季增1.88%，年增8.68%；EBITDA 113.14億元，季減1.59%，年增6.45%；稅後純益42.7億元，季減6.15%，年增18.61%，每股純益1.4元。
台灣大累計今年前三季營收1495.8億元，年增5.36%；EBITDA 341.65億元，年增7.53%；稅後純益129.5億元，年增22.87%，每股純益4.26元。
台灣大指出，受惠iPhone換機熱潮與企業電信事業驅動下全速運轉，推升9月營收年增逾1成。
Telco電信本業方面，iPhone 18 Pro系列開賣帶動買氣，申辦用戶中逾7成選擇搭配月租1399元以上高資費方案，帶動單月銷貨收入年增20%，另一方面，受惠於全光速等高速家用寬頻服務驅動，家戶事業營收也年增15%；Telco+企業事業方面，受惠AIDC收入挹注，單月營收年增幅顯著跳升。
Telco+Tech科技事業方面，momo營收年增8%，增幅續創今年新高，品牌電商受惠新代理品牌3COINS首店開幕，成長動能進一步提升。
遠傳累計今年前三季營收862.3億元，年增11.04%；EBITDA 303.18億元，年增7.28%；稅後純益113.92億元，年增13.24%，每股純益3.16元。
遠傳指出，受惠電信本業、個人數位生活及智慧資通訊三大成長引擎穩健發展，各項財務指標均優於年度財測目標，第三季EPS達成率達105%，前三季EPS達成率更達110%。
遠傳電信本業穩健成長，9月總用戶數持續擴大。月租型用戶5G滲透率突破5成大關，與4G用戶數達成黃金交叉。隨著iPhone新機買氣帶動5G升級潮，月租型用戶每月平均貢獻度(ARPU)穩定向上，推升行動服務營收達53.39億元。
遠傳企業智慧資通訊維持良好成長動能，9月受惠雲端專案順利交付，相關業務營收持續增溫。此外，為協助企業加速數位轉型與AI應用落地，遠傳成為全台首家取得GitHub AI開發顧問資格的企業，並將成立「遠傳AI開發顧問團隊」。

items.title: 國營事業投4843億12項虧爆？ 經部力挺：油電價長年凍漲侵蝕自有資金
items.title_en: State-Owned Enterprises Invest NT$484.3 Billion in 12 Loss-Making Projects? Ministry of Economic Affairs Defends: Long-Term Frozen Oil and Electricity Prices Erode Own Funds
paras: 針對媒體報導「近10年新高，67項專案八成靠借錢或政府增資，國營事業投資4843億，12項虧爆」，經濟部今（12）日表示，所屬國營事業肩負國家發展與民生福祉重任，各項投資本質上屬公共性與公益性的國家基礎建設，核心價值在於強化國家整體能源與基礎設施的韌性，並非以追求商業盈利為唯一目的，相關計畫均經過嚴謹的效益評估及外部效益考量；並強調中油及台電公司長期凍漲油電價導致其累積虧損增加，僅能仰賴舉債或政府增資因應。
經濟部說明，依據「國營事業固定資產投資計畫編製評估要點」第4點規定，投資計畫之內部報酬率大於資金成本率且淨現值為正者方可投資。但屬配合政府重大政策、具有經濟效益或推動永續發展者，不在此限。其中部分水、電、油氣建設因具有環境保護、能源轉型等重大外部效益，依規定計入後，各項投資計畫實有其投資效益。
針對報載所屬事業12項專案計畫，經濟部指出，中油公司包括第三接收站在內等多項天然氣投資計畫，具有穩定國內天然氣供應、提升安全存量之外部效益；大林石化油品儲運中心投資計畫則係配合節能減碳政策，將前鎮儲運所及散居在高雄舊港區並毗鄰市區的石化碼頭與儲槽遷移集中管理。
台電公司方面，離岸風力加強電力網等2項係為執行政府離岸風力政策，具帶動國內離岸風力相關產業發展之效益；南科超高壓變電所擴建計畫則可增加南部科學園區供電能力與電力品質；另霧社水庫防淤工程計畫可提高水庫排洪與防淤能力、有利中部地區生活及產業之用水穩定性，兼具提升農業產值及觀光等效益。
台水公司3項供水計畫可提升供水效率與管網韌性。至於台糖公司生質能中心投資計畫，係配合政策推動116年起全面禁止廚餘養豬，協助廚餘資源化及能源化，降低環境衝擊，並提升國內生質能發電量能，以兼顧動物防疫、環境永續及能源轉型等政策目標，雖不具財務投資效益，但仍具有協助處理國內廚餘及增加生質能發展再生能源等外部環境及社會效益。
經濟部強調，所屬事業因應國際局勢及物價波動情勢，充分發揮穩定物價與照顧民生之關鍵角色，但亦付出高額成本。中油及台電公司無法如民間企業般隨市場行情隨時反映成本，長期凍漲油氣及電價導致其累積虧損增加，也造成各事業自有資金不足影響投資能力，僅能仰賴舉債或政府增資因應。
經濟部補充，為確保國家能源轉型、水資源開發及電網強韌等重大基礎建設不中斷，近年已多次編列預算增資各事業或協助各事業適度對外借款籌資。今年因中東衝突造成國際能源價格飆漲，中油、台電公司面臨財務挑戰尤烈，希望立法院能支持經濟部的撥補追加預算，方能確保油水電穩定供應、維持物價平穩及健全事業營運。
paras_en: In response to media reports that "investment by state-owned enterprises has reached a ten‑year high, with 67 projects 80% funded by borrowing or government capital injections, a total investment of NT$484.3 billion and 12 projects operating at a loss," the Ministry of Economic Affairs said on the 12th that its state‑owned enterprises bear the nation’s development and public‑welfare responsibilities. Their investments are fundamentally public‑interest infrastructure aimed at strengthening the country’s overall energy and infrastructure resilience, not solely for commercial profit. All projects have undergone rigorous benefit assessments and consideration of external benefits; the ministry also stressed that the long‑term freeze on oil and electricity prices at CPC and Taipower has increased their accumulated losses, leaving them to rely on borrowing or government capital injections.

The ministry explained that, according to point 4 of the “Guidelines for Preparing and Evaluating Fixed‑Asset Investment Plans of State‑Owned Enterprises,” a project may be invested in only if its internal rate of return exceeds the cost of capital and its net present value is positive. However, projects that support major government policies, generate economic benefits, or promote sustainable development are exempt from this rule. Certain water, electricity, and oil‑gas constructions, because they deliver significant environmental protection and energy‑transition external benefits, are counted as investments after applying the regulations, and they indeed have investment merit.

Regarding the 12 projects cited, the ministry noted that CPC’s natural‑gas investments, including the third receiving station, provide stable domestic gas supply and enhance safety stock, delivering external benefits. The Dali petrochemical oil‑product storage and transport centre aligns with energy‑saving and carbon‑reduction policies, consolidating the Qianzhen storage facility and the scattered petrochemical terminal and tanks in Kaohsiung’s old port area into a single, centrally managed site.

For Taipower, two projects—offshore wind integration into the power grid and related upgrades—implement the government’s offshore wind policy and stimulate domestic offshore‑wind industry development. The expansion of the Southern Science Park ultra‑high‑voltage substation will increase power supply capacity and quality for the southern science park. Additionally, the Wushe Reservoir sediment‑control project will improve flood discharge and sediment‑removal capacity, stabilising water supply for central‑region residents and industry, while also boosting agricultural output and tourism benefits.

Taiwan Water Corporation’s three water‑supply projects will improve delivery efficiency and network resilience. Taiwan Sugar’s bio‑energy centre project supports the policy banning the use of food‑waste for pig‑raising from 2027, helping to convert food‑waste into resources and energy, reducing environmental impact and raising domestic bio‑energy generation. Although it lacks direct financial returns, it provides external environmental and social benefits such as waste handling and renewable‑energy development.

The ministry emphasized that its enterprises play a key role in stabilising prices and caring for livelihoods amid international tensions and price volatility, but this comes at high cost. CPC and Taipower cannot adjust prices like private firms in response to market conditions; the prolonged freeze on oil‑gas and electricity prices has increased their cumulative losses, depleted their own capital, and limited investment capacity, forcing reliance on borrowing or government capital injections.

The ministry added that to ensure uninterrupted progress on major infrastructure—energy transition, water‑resource development, and grid resilience—it has repeatedly allocated budget increases or facilitated external borrowing for the enterprises. This year, the Middle‑East conflict has driven up global energy prices, intensifying financial challenges for CPC and Taipower. The ministry hopes the Legislative Yuan will back additional budget allocations, securing stable oil, water, and electricity supplies, price stability, and sound enterprise operations.

items.title: 〈台塑四寶業績〉四寶Q3賺762億元季增18% 南亞前3季賺逾1股本、台塑化同步創高
items.title_en: Formosa Plastics' Four Treasures Q3 Profit 76.279 Billion TWD, Up 18% YoY; Nan Ya Posts Over One Share Capital in First Three Quarters, Formosa Plastics Chemical Hits New High
paras: 台塑四寶今(12)日公布自結今(2026)年第3季獲利及展望說明，四間公司單季稅後純益為762.79億元、季增18.7%，前3季稅後純益1,847.27億元，皆較去年同期轉盈。其中南亞(1303-TW)及台塑化(6505-TW)受惠電子材料、油價高檔挹注獲利，單季獲利皆創新高，前三季累計獲利亦創歷史同期新高。
南亞第3季稅後純益388.3億元、季增45.2%、EPS為4.9元，累計前3季獲利798.41億元，EPS為10.07元，單季、前3季創同期新高，今年累計已賺超過一股本。
南亞表示，主要第3季本業營業利益及轉投資南亞科(2408-TW)投資收益大幅成長所致，今年以來AI 相關產業以飛快速度擴張資本支出，致電子材料供應極度緊缺、價格高漲，利潤水漲船高，且業界用料規格快速升級，也讓研發效能與材料的料源掌握度成為搶占供應鏈的關鍵能力，並推進了產品認證與量產時程，帶動產品業績快速成長。
台塑化單季稅後純益262.89億元、季增26.5%，EPS為2.76元，創單季同期新高，前3季稅後純益674.74億元，EPS 7.08元，也改寫同期新高。
台塑化指出，第3季中東原油到貨回穩，煉油事業營業額年增31.8%，產能利用率回升至91.2%、季增24.7%。
台塑第3季單季稅後純益為57.39億元、季減46.1%，前3季稅後純益196.6億元、EPS為3.09元。
台塑說明，主要受美伊戰爭爆發影響高油價，加上第3季因美伊戰事反覆，原油及原料乙烯、丙烯價格維持高檔，加上全球高通膨影響終端需求，產品售價無法完全轉嫁成本，利差縮小，致使第3季本業虧損，第3季各主要產品平均價格比第2季下跌，幅度介於5-18%。
台化(1326-TW)單季稅後純益為54.18億元、季減11%，EPS為0.92元，前3季稅後純益177.52億元，EPS為3.03元。
台化指出，第2季油價自高點回落，第3季美伊協議崩潰衝突加劇，再次推升油價，第3季均價仍低於第2季，且下游業者無法吸收高價成本，壓抑石化行情漲幅，台化將以推動精實生產及提升差異化產品占比，因應市況適時調整產銷改善獲利。另台化在營業外淨收益增加179 億元，主要受惠於權益法投資收益及轉投資現金股利收益挹注。
paras_en: Formosa Plastics' Four Treasures announced today (12th) its self‑calculated Q3 2026 profit and outlook. The four companies posted a combined after‑tax net profit of NT$76.279 billion for the quarter, up 18.7% sequentially, and NT$184.727 billion for the first three quarters, all turning to profit compared with the same period last year. Nan Ya (1303‑TW) and Formosa Plastics Chemical (6505‑TW) benefited from electronic materials and high oil prices, achieving record quarterly profits and historic cumulative profits for the first three quarters.

Nan Ya reported Q3 after‑tax net profit of NT$38.83 billion, up 45.2% sequentially, with EPS of NT$4.90. Cumulative profit for the first three quarters reached NT$79.841 billion, EPS NT$10.07, both new highs for the period, and the company has already earned more than one share capital this year.

Nan Ya said the strong Q3 results were driven by a sharp rise in operating profit from its core business and investment income from its affiliate Nan Ya Technology (2408‑TW). Rapid AI‑related capital spending this year has created severe shortages and price hikes in electronic materials, boosting margins. Faster upgrades in material specifications have made R&D efficiency and material sourcing key competitive factors, accelerating product certification, mass‑production schedules and sales growth.

Formosa Plastics Chemical posted a quarterly after‑tax net profit of NT$26.289 billion, up 26.5% sequentially, with EPS of NT$2.76, a new quarterly high. For the first three quarters, net profit was NT$67.474 billion, EPS NT$7.08, also a new record for the period.

Formosa Plastics Chemical noted that Middle‑East crude oil deliveries stabilized in Q3, with refining revenue up 31.8% year‑on‑year and capacity utilization rising to 91.2%, a 24.7% sequential increase.
Formosa Plastics reported a quarterly after‑tax net profit of NT$5.739 billion, down 46.1% sequentially, and cumulative profit of NT$19.66 billion for the first three quarters, with EPS of NT$3.09.

Formosa Plastics explained that the main headwinds were high oil prices triggered by the outbreak of the US‑Iran war, and continued price pressure on crude oil, ethylene and propylene in Q3 due to the conflict. Combined with global high inflation suppressing end‑user demand, product prices could not fully pass on costs, narrowing margins and resulting in an operating loss for the quarter. Average prices of major products fell 5‑18% versus Q2.

Chia Hwa (1326‑TW) posted a quarterly after‑tax net profit of NT$5.418 billion, down 11% sequentially, with EPS of NT$0.92, and cumulative profit of NT$17.752 billion for the first three quarters, EPS NT$3.03.

Chia Hwa said oil prices fell from their peak in Q2, but the collapse of the US‑Iran agreement in Q3 reignited conflict and pushed oil prices up again, keeping the Q3 average below Q2 levels. Downstream customers could not absorb the higher costs, limiting petrochemical price gains. The company will pursue lean manufacturing and increase the share of differentiated products to adapt to market conditions and improve profitability. Non‑operating net income rose NT$17.9 billion, driven by equity‑method investment gains and cash dividends from affiliates.

items.title: 台股小跌11點外資再賣522億元 調節台塑四寶、晶圓代工族群
items.title_en: Taiwan stocks slip 11 points as foreign investors sell NT$52.2 billion, adjusting holdings in Formosa Plastics’ four jewels and wafer‑foundry groups
paras: 台股今(12)日跌11.48點收49301.96點，外資再賣近522億元，連4賣共1477億元；外資今日賣超台塑四寶共6.65萬張外，也賣超台積電等晶圓代工族群，反手大買台新新光金、台泥以及中鋼等各逾3萬張。

外資金融股賣超台中銀1.13萬張較多，另也賣超元大台灣50(0050) 2.30萬張、群益ESG投等債20+(00937B) 1.09萬張、大華韓國KOSPI50(009829) 1.05萬張、復華富時不動產(00712) 9,539張等ETF。

paras_en: Taiwan’s main board fell 11.48 points today, closing at 49,301.96 points. Foreign investors sold nearly NT$52.2 billion, bringing their total four‑day net sales to NT$147.7 billion. They sold a net 66,500 contracts of Formosa Plastics’ “four jewels” and also sold net positions in TSMC and other wafer‑foundry stocks, while on the flip side they bought more than 30,000 contracts each of Taishin Financial, Shin Kong Financial, Taiwan Cement and China Steel.

On the buying side, foreign investors bought a net 37,200 contracts of Taishin Shin Kong Financial, the largest purchase, with other financial stocks including Kai Fund 29,400 contracts, and over 12,000 contracts each of CTBC Financial, Yuanta Financial and others. They also bought 36,200 contracts of Taiwan Cement, 30,000 contracts of China Steel, 14,900 contracts of Kuokuang, as well as container shipping stocks Yang Ming 20,100 contracts and Evergreen 12,000 contracts.

items.title: 追思金融教母侯金英 楊金龍念師恩一度哽咽 周添財細數18年經營智慧
items.title_en: Remembering Financial Matriarch Hou Jin‑ying, Yang Jin‑long Choked Up with Gratitude, Zhou Tian‑cai Recalls 18 Years of Wisdom
paras: 由台灣金融研訓院、政大金融學系及政大金融系友會共同舉辦的「承志與創新－侯金英董事長紀念論壇」，今(12)日在研訓院菁業堂隆重舉行。活動匯聚金融主管機關代表與產業領袖，共同追思被譽為「臺灣金融教母」的侯金英女士。其中，中央銀行總裁楊金龍追思恩師感念情深，致詞時一度哽咽；遠東商銀董事長周添財則以「後輩與工作夥伴」的身分，分享與侯金英在遠東銀共事18年的珍貴回憶。
與遠東商銀董事長周添財的感人致詞，兩人分別從「學生」與「事業夥伴」的角度，深情回憶侯金英對台灣金融業與教育界的深遠影響。
楊金龍致詞時感性表示，今日不只是一場紀念，更是老朋友、老同學與老學生的聚會。他回憶自己大四時，侯金英老師正是他的導師，曾親自授課個體與總體經濟學，「侯老師講課清晰有架構，教室總是坐得滿滿的；她每次走進教室時的親切笑容與優雅得體的氣質，至今仍歷歷在目。」
楊金龍特別提到侯老師與其夫婿—央行前總裁梁國樹之間的深厚情誼與奉獻。他分享1994年擔任央行倫敦代表辦事處首任主任時，梁總裁與侯老師一同赴英視察，梁總裁還特別帶著他拜會當時的英格蘭銀行總裁，這份提攜後進的用心讓他終生感念。
談及侯老師一生培育人才無數，並在梁前總裁離世後勇敢承擔重任，建立金融研訓院制度與金融證照體系，楊金龍回憶起侯老師離世前的珍貴畫面與教誨，情緒湧上心頭、一度哽咽。他動容地表示：「身為侯老師的學生，我一直以受教於她為榮。今天不只想說懷念，更想說：『侯老師，謝謝您！』雖然您已離開，但您的精神將隨著一代又一代的努力繼續傳承下去。」
周添財則分享與侯金英在遠東商銀共事的回憶，他讚佩侯董事長即使高齡九十多歲，仍天天準時上班、親自主持晨會，將「做什麼就要像什麼」的精神發揮到極致。
周添財也分享了許多鮮為人知的溫馨細節，研訓院菁業堂的無噪音座椅，正是當年侯董事長特別遠赴日本請教設計師的成果；而每次開董事會前，她都會花三天時間將議程密密麻麻寫滿紅字註記，展現嚴謹態度。
侯董事長曾對身為總經理的周添財叮嚀，「業績若因時局無法達標沒關係，但我們一定要誠實守法，員工品格要好，贏得客戶信任才能永續經營。」她常將「敬業、盡責、凡事善解」八個字寫在手機套上記錄，管理上堅持底線卻極具厚道，指出問題時永遠給人留餘地。
周添財感嘆，侯董事長辦公室掛著「傲骨、經霜」的字畫，正是她一生的寫照。她帶給遠東商銀的不只是優異的經營成果，更是一種愛人的厚道與對法紀的堅持，其身影早已融入企業文化之中。
paras_en: The "Commitment and Innovation – Chairman Hou Jin‑ying Memorial Forum" co‑hosted by the Taiwan Institute of Financial Training, the National Chengchi University Department of Finance and its alumni association was held today (the 12th) at the Institute’s Jingye Hall. The event gathered representatives from financial regulators and industry leaders to pay tribute to Ms. Hou Jin‑ying, hailed as the "Mother of Taiwan Finance." Central Bank Governor Yang Jin‑long, recalling his mentor, became choked with emotion during his speech; Far East Commercial Bank Chairman Zhou Tian‑cai, speaking as a junior colleague and work partner, shared precious memories of working with Hou at Far East Bank for 18 years.

In his moving remarks, Chairman Zhou Tian‑cai and Governor Yang each recalled Hou Jin‑ying’s profound impact on Taiwan’s financial sector and education from the perspectives of a "student" and a "career partner."

Governor Yang spoke emotionally, noting that today is not only a memorial but also a gathering of old friends, classmates and former students. He recalled that when he was a senior in college, Hou Jin‑ying was his instructor, personally teaching micro‑ and macro‑economics. "Professor Hou’s lectures were clear and well‑structured, and the classroom was always full; her warm smile and elegant demeanor when she entered the room are still vivid in my memory," he said.

Yang highlighted the deep friendship and dedication between Professor Hou and her husband, former Central Bank Governor Liang Guo‑shu. He recounted that in 1994, while serving as the first director of the Central Bank’s London office, Governor Liang and Professor Hou traveled to the UK together, and Liang even arranged a meeting with the then Governor of the Bank of England, a gesture of mentorship that Yang will never forget.

Speaking of Professor Hou’s lifelong dedication to nurturing talent, Yang recalled how, after Governor Liang’s passing, she bravely shouldered the responsibility of establishing the Institute’s training system and financial certification framework. He described a poignant scene and teaching she shared before her death, which brought him to tears. "As her student, I am proud to have been taught by her. Today I not only miss her but also want to say, ‘Professor Hou, thank you!’ Though you have left us, your spirit will continue to be passed down through generations of effort," he said.

Zhou Tian‑cai shared his memories of working with Chairman Hou at Far East Commercial Bank, praising her for still coming to work every day, even in her nineties, and personally leading the morning meetings, embodying the principle of “be what you do.”

Zhou also revealed many little‑known, heart‑warming details: the noise‑free chairs in the Institute’s Jingye Hall were the result of Chairman Hou’s trip to Japan to consult a designer; before each board meeting she would spend three days filling the agenda with dense red‑ink notes, demonstrating her meticulous attitude.

Chairman Hou once reminded General Manager Zhou, "It’s okay if performance falls short due to the external environment, but we must always be honest, law‑abiding, and maintain good character among employees; earning customer trust is essential for sustainable operation." She often wrote the eight characters “dedication, responsibility, and kindness in all matters” on her phone case, upholding strict standards while remaining generous, and always leaving room for dialogue when pointing out issues.

Zhou reflected that Chairman Hou’s office displayed a painting titled “Stubborn Bone, Frost‑Seasoned,” which perfectly described her life. She gave Far East Commercial Bank not only outstanding results but also a spirit of kindness and steadfast respect for law, a legacy that has become ingrained in the company’s culture.

items.title: 晶片買得到、錢卻更難找！博通執行長點破AI擴張難題
items.title_en: Chips Are Obtainable, But Money Is Even Harder to Find! Broadcom CEO Pinpoints AI Expansion Challenge
paras: AI擴張最怕的，可能已不是缺晶片，而是錢不夠。博通(AVGO-US)執行長陳福陽周一(12日)表示，取得資金如今已成為AI成長的最大限制。隨著建置與擴充AI系統的成本逐年攀升，籌措資金正變得比取得晶片更困難。
博通為大型資料中心供應客製化AI晶片與網路零組件，客戶包括開發及營運先進AI模型的企業，相關產品需求依然強勁。公司先前已將截至2027年10月止年度的AI晶片營收展望上調至約1,150億美元，並預期2028會計年度將達約2,300億美元。
然而，需求強勁不代表擴建計畫就能順利推進。資料中心在開始創造收入之前，企業就得先投入大筆資金，支付建築、運算設備及網路設施等成本，投資回報卻可能要等上數年。
許多企業仰賴舉債支應這些支出，但利率上升推高借款成本，投資人也更加仔細檢視獲利、穩定現金流，以及能否明確說明如何回收投資。從AI開發商、雲端服務供應商到資料中心營運商，都面臨同一個問題：未來創造的收入，是否足以支撐眼前的龐大投入？
即使取得晶片，也不代表運算產能能立即增加。資料中心還需要穩定供電、合適用地及完工的建築，任何一個環節延誤，都可能讓計畫停滯，即便晶片已經備妥也不例外。
陳福陽發表上述看法之際，科技業即將陸續公布最新財報，AI支出預料仍將是企業投資計畫的重心。不過，利率攀升與企業債務增加，可能讓這些擴張計畫承受更大壓力。
他的談話反映出AI產業成長瓶頸的轉變。過去市場主要擔心晶片供應能否跟上需求，如今焦點則轉向企業是否有能力負擔擴張成本。
未來能以合理成本取得資金，並將龐大支出轉化為穩定回報的企業，可能最有能力加速擴張；籌資與投資回收能力不足的業者，即使面對強勁AI需求，也可能被迫放慢腳步。
paras_en: AI expansion’s biggest fear may no longer be a chip shortage but a lack of money. Broadcom (AVGO-US) CEO Hock Tan said on Monday (the 12th) that securing financing has become the greatest constraint on AI growth. As the cost of building and scaling AI systems rises year after year, raising capital is becoming harder than obtaining chips.

Broadcom supplies custom AI chips and networking components to large data centers, serving customers that develop and operate advanced AI models, and demand for its related products remains strong. The company has already raised its AI chip revenue outlook for the fiscal year ending October 2027 to roughly $115 billion and expects fiscal 2028 revenue of about $230 billion.

However, strong demand does not guarantee that expansion plans will proceed smoothly. Before data centers can generate revenue, companies must first invest large sums in construction, compute hardware and networking infrastructure, and the return on that investment may not materialize for several years.

Many firms rely on borrowing to fund these expenditures, but rising interest rates have pushed up borrowing costs, and investors are scrutinizing profitability, stable cash flow, and whether companies can clearly explain how they will recoup their investments. AI developers, cloud service providers and data‑center operators all face the same question: will future revenue be sufficient to support the massive upfront outlays?

Even when chips are secured, compute capacity does not instantly increase. Data centers also need reliable power, suitable sites and completed buildings; any delay in one of these elements can stall a project, even if the chips are ready.

Tan made these remarks as the tech sector prepares to release its latest earnings, with AI spending still expected to be a core focus of corporate investment plans. Yet higher rates and rising corporate debt could put additional pressure on these expansion projects.

His comments reflect a shift in the bottleneck to AI industry growth. In the past, the market mainly worried about whether chip supply could keep pace with demand; now the focus has moved to whether companies can afford the cost of expansion.

Companies that can obtain financing at reasonable costs and turn large expenditures into stable returns are likely to be the most capable of accelerating expansion, while those lacking fundraising and investment‑recovery capacity may be forced to slow down even amid strong AI demand.

items.title: 年底還能再漲一波？標普500企業獲利估增25% 全球股市等財報拿出真本事
items.title_en: Can the Market Still Rally at Year‑End? S&P 500 Earnings Expected to Grow 25% as Global Stocks Await Strong Reports
paras: 全球股市想在年底再衝一波，企業財報得先拿出真本事。通膨疑慮再起、債市波動加劇，加上人工智慧(AI)支出引發疑慮，讓股市漲勢陷入停頓。在歐美股市仍接近歷史高點之際，即將登場的第三季財報，不僅要交出獲利成長，更得證明高估值與後續漲勢有基本面支撐。
據《彭博》報導，摩根大通(JPM-US)、高盛(GS-US)等美國大型銀行將於周二揭開財報季序幕。彭博行業研究(BI)彙整資料顯示，標普500指數成分企業第三季獲利預估年增25%；花旗(C-US)模型則預測，本季美國企業獲利優於預期的比例將高於上一季，以科技、醫療保健及礦業表現領先。
Leverage Shares資深研究分析師Violeta Todorova表示，這次財報季未必決定股市成敗，卻是企業必須「拿出證據」的時刻，因為市場已拉高標準，漲勢需要進一步確認。過去企業往往只須跨過下修後的門檻，這次卻得跳過更高的標竿。
MSCI全球股票指數自8月中旬創下新高後便陷入停滯，分析師卻持續上修獲利預估，使估值降至平均水準以下。不過，投資人仍擔心消費支出放緩，最終拖累整體經濟成長。

AI財報門檻愈墊愈高 獲利成長須擴及其他產業

AI仍是本季財報焦點。BI資料顯示，美國AI相關企業第三季獲利預估年增47%，成長幅度僅次於能源業；資訊科技業今年預料將貢獻標普500企業整體獲利的三分之一。亞洲方面，受惠於AI需求，台灣與南韓企業預期將帶動區域獲利成長66%。
然而，MSCI全球資訊科技指數今年已上漲31%，並攀上歷史新高，意味企業必須交出更亮眼的成績，才能推動股價續漲。Roundhill Financial執行長Dave Mazza表示，單純繳出優於預期的財報並上調展望，已被市場視為理所當然；企業還得提高全年財測，並證明能維持獲利率。
美光(MU-US)本月稍早公布的業績優於預期，也指出AI相關需求具有持續性，市場反應卻平淡。三星電子(005930-KR)上季營業利益增至接近去年同期的9倍，股價上周仍下跌2.4%，凸顯市場對AI受惠企業的要求愈來愈高。
Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)、Meta(META-US)及甲骨文(ORCL-US)等大型雲端業者持續投資資料中心，也提振電網營運商與基礎建設供應商的展望。不過，隨著公債殖利率急升，企業籌資步調令投資人不安。SpaceX(SPCX-US)的一項信用風險指標上周升至新高，其債券在次級市場的價格也走弱。
除了科技業，投資人也希望消費、工業及銀行等景氣敏感產業能加入獲利成長行列。CG Asset Management投資組合經理Emma Moriarty表示，非科技產業的財報有助判斷整體經濟狀況，也能觀察是否出現AI及相關服務表現強勁、其他產業相對疲弱的兩樣情。
摩根士丹利(MS-US)策略師Michael Wilson指出，羅素3000指數成分股獲利成長率的中位數，2026年可望達14%，顯示基本面仍強健。其中，工業類股獲利預估持續獲得上修，估值則較夏季回落；獲利品質、自由現金流，以及獲利預估上修是否擴及更多企業，將成為區分表現的關鍵。

歐亞股市各有優勢 消費疲弱仍是共同考驗

歐洲市場提供不同於美國科技股的投資選擇。高盛追蹤的一籃子歐洲資本密集型股票，表現優於較依賴人力或數位資產的輕資產產業。這類被稱為HALO，即「重資產、低淘汰風險」的股票，涵蓋公用事業及能源等產業，被視為較不易受到AI相關波動衝擊。
RootBridge Capital管理合夥人Alpesh Patel表示，歐洲的優勢在於價格，以及不同的獲利來源。科技股僅占道瓊歐洲600指數約10%，若龐大的AI資本支出開始形成負擔，這樣的產業結構可提供部分避險效果。
亞洲方面，MSCI亞太指數今年表現優於標普500及道瓊歐洲600指數，但投資人同樣希望確認，獲利成長能否從深度參與AI供應鏈的科技業，擴散至其他產業。
消費正是主要考驗之一。能源價格上漲推高燃料成本，公債殖利率攀升則推升房貸、車貸及信用卡利率，壓縮家庭購買力，也使消費相關產業成為今年表現最落後的族群之一。
初步財報訊號並不亮眼。好市多(COST-US)單季獲利雖優於預期，付費會員人數增幅卻不如市場預估。瑞典服飾零售商H&M(瑞典股市代號HM B)也因分析師指出，剔除美國關稅退款效益後，獲利率明顯下滑，股價因而走低。
中國消費企業則在缺乏大規模刺激措施之下，持續面臨支出低迷與信心脆弱的壓力。eToro(ETOR-US)亞太首席分析師Josh Gilbert表示，最佳進場時點往往出現在展望仍黯淡之際，但目前油價與利率仍朝不利方向變動，亞洲消費股的布局時機似乎尚未到來。

高利率從助力變壓力 銀行財報聚焦放款與信用品質

銀行股今年稍早受惠於殖利率上升，市場看好放款利差擴大；但隨著利率持續攀升，投資人開始更關注信用品質、放款成長與資本市場業務能否承受壓力。
歐洲銀行業還面臨法國財政疑慮衝擊。原本是區域表現最佳類股之一的道瓊歐洲600銀行指數，過去兩周已下跌約8%。
摩根大通私人銀行歐洲、中東及非洲股票策略主管Nataliia Lipikhina表示，市場將檢視銀行放款成長是否依然強勁；不過，就投資組合配置而言，團隊仍偏好將新增資金投入美國或新興市場。
摩根大通上周也轉而對東南亞銀行業抱持審慎態度，警告長天期公債殖利率急升，可能導致按市價評價損失，並壓抑資本市場業務收入。分析師Harsh Wardhan Modi指出，旗下追蹤的多家銀行在2026年第三季較可能出現負面意外，因此建議客戶降低配置。
paras_en: Global equity markets hope to push higher before year‑end, but corporate earnings must deliver. Renewed inflation worries, heightened bond‑market volatility, and concerns over AI spending have stalled the rally. As U.S. and European markets linger near historic highs, the upcoming Q3 earnings season must not only show profit growth but also prove that lofty valuations and further upside have fundamental support.

Bloomberg reports that major U.S. banks such as JPMorgan (JPM‑US) and Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) will kick off earnings season on Tuesday. Bloomberg Intelligence data show that S&P 500 constituents are projected to post a 25% year‑over‑year profit increase for Q3, while Citi’s (C‑US) model expects the proportion of U.S. companies beating earnings expectations this quarter to exceed the prior quarter, led by technology, healthcare and mining sectors.

Leverage Shares senior analyst Violeta Todorova says this earnings season may not decide the market’s fate, but it is the moment for companies to “show the evidence” because the market’s baseline has been raised and any rally needs further confirmation. In the past firms only had to clear a lowered hurdle after cuts; this time they must clear a higher bar.

Since mid‑August the MSCI World Index has stalled after hitting a fresh high, yet analysts keep lifting profit forecasts, pulling valuations below average levels. Nevertheless, investors remain uneasy about slowing consumer spending, which could ultimately drag down overall economic growth.

AI remains the focal point of this quarter’s reports. Bloomberg Intelligence data indicate that U.S. AI‑related firms are expected to see a 47% year‑over‑year profit rise in Q3, second only to energy. The information‑technology sector is slated to contribute about one‑third of total S&P 500 earnings this year. In Asia, AI demand is expected to lift Taiwanese and South Korean companies’ regional profit growth by 66%.

However, the MSCI World Information‑Technology Index is already up 31% this year and has reached a historic peak, meaning firms must deliver even brighter results to keep stock prices climbing. Roundhill Financial CEO Dave Mazza notes that simply beating expectations and raising guidance is now taken for granted; companies must also lift full‑year forecasts and prove they can sustain profit margins.

Micron (MU‑US) posted better‑than‑expected results earlier this month and highlighted the durability of AI‑related demand, yet the market reaction was muted. Samsung Electronics (005930‑KR) saw operating profit rise to nearly nine times its level a year ago, but its share price fell 2.4% last week, underscoring the growing scrutiny on AI‑benefiting firms.

Big cloud players such as Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Meta (META‑US) and Oracle (ORCL‑US) continue to invest in data centers, boosting outlooks for power‑grid operators and infrastructure suppliers. Yet soaring sovereign‑bond yields have made corporate financing pace a source of investor anxiety. SpaceX’s (SPCX‑US) credit‑risk indicator spiked to a new high last week, and its bonds weakened in the secondary market.

Beyond tech, investors hope that consumer, industrial and banking sectors—traditionally sensitive to the business cycle—will also join the profit‑growth story. CG Asset Management portfolio manager Emma Moriarty says non‑tech earnings help gauge the broader economy and reveal whether AI and related services are strong while other industries lag.

Morgan Stanley (MS‑US) strategist Michael Wilson points out that the median profit‑growth rate for Russell 3000 constituents could reach 14% by 2026, indicating robust fundamentals. Industrial stocks continue to receive profit‑forecast upgrades, with valuations retreating from summer peaks; the quality of earnings, free‑cash‑flow generation and the breadth of profit‑forecast revisions will be key performance differentiators.

European and Asian markets each have their own strengths, but weak consumer demand remains a shared challenge. Europe offers investment options distinct from U.S. tech stocks. Goldman Sachs tracks a basket of European capital‑intensive equities that outperforms lighter‑asset sectors reliant on labor or digital assets. These “HALO” stocks—heavy‑asset, low‑obsolescence names such as utilities and energy—are seen as less vulnerable to AI‑related volatility.

RootBridge Capital partner Alpesh Patel says Europe’s advantage lies in pricing and diversified profit sources. Technology makes up only about 10% of the Dow Jones Europe 600, so if massive AI capex becomes a burden, this sector composition can provide a partial hedge.

In Asia, the MSCI Asia‑Pacific Index has outperformed both the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Europe 600 this year, but investors still want confirmation that profit growth can spread from AI‑heavy tech firms to other industries.

Consumer spending is a primary test. Rising energy prices lift fuel costs, while higher sovereign yields push up mortgage, auto‑loan and credit‑card rates, squeezing household purchasing power and making consumer‑related sectors among the weakest performers this year.

Early earnings signals are underwhelming. Costco (COST‑US) posted quarterly profit above forecasts, yet membership growth lagged expectations. Swedish apparel retailer H&M (HM B) saw its profit margin tumble once analysts stripped out the benefit of U.S. tariff refunds, sending the stock lower.

Chinese consumer firms continue to face weak spending and fragile confidence without large‑scale stimulus. eToro (ETOR‑US) Asia‑Pacific chief analyst Josh Gilbert notes that the best entry points often appear when outlooks are bleak, but with oil prices and rates moving unfavorably, the timing for Asian consumer stocks still seems premature.

High rates have shifted from a tailwind to a drag, focusing bank earnings on loan growth and credit quality. Earlier this year banks benefited from rising yields and widening loan spreads, but as rates keep climbing investors are scrutinizing credit quality, loan‑book expansion and capital‑market resilience.
European banks also grapple with fiscal concerns in France. The Dow Jones Europe 600 banking index, once a top regional performer, has fallen about 8% over the past two weeks.

JPMorgan private‑bank Europe, Middle East and Africa equities strategy head Nataliia Lipikhina says the market will watch whether bank loan growth remains robust; however, in terms of portfolio allocation the team still prefers directing new capital to the U.S. or emerging markets.

JPMorgan last week turned more cautious on Southeast Asian banks, warning that sharply rising long‑term sovereign yields could trigger mark‑to‑market losses and suppress capital‑market revenue. Analyst Harsh Wardhan Modi notes that several of the firm’s tracked banks could face adverse events in Q3 2026, prompting a recommendation to reduce exposure.

items.title_en: U.S. Stock Futures Mixed; Oil Holds Above $100, Bank Earnings and Inflation Data in Focus
paras: 2026年10月12日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股週一(12日)盤前走勢平淡，國際油價持續維持在每桶100美元以上，投資人關注中東局勢、即將公布的銀行財報，以及本週美國通膨數據，評估聯準會(Fed)後續利率政策方向。

國際油價持續受到地緣政治局勢影響。美國總統川普表示，俄羅斯與烏克蘭已同意停止攻擊彼此的能源設施，但協議細節仍不明朗，加上週末沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德國際機場遭到致命攻擊，中東衝突持續支撐布蘭特原油價格維持在每桶100美元以上。

企業財報方面，美股第三季財報季將於週二登場，富國銀行(WFC-US)、高盛(GS-US)、花旗集團(C-US)及摩根大通(JPM-US)等大型銀行將陸續公布業績。市場預估標普500企業第三季獲利年增30.6%，AI相關投資與企業獲利成長能否符合市場期待，將成為觀察重點。
另一方面，高油價也讓通膨壓力重新受到關注。美國公債殖利率本月稍早攀升至24年高點，市場擔心能源價格上漲可能使通膨維持高檔，限制Fed調整利率的空間。
市場預估，本週公布的美國消費者物價指數(CPI)月增率可能達0.6%，年增率為3.7%；核心CPI月增率預估為0.2%，年增率為2.5%。根據CME FedWatch工具，市場目前預估Fed本月升息機率約19%。
個股方面，資料中心業者IREN(IREN-US)盤前上漲5.4%。根據《The Information》報導，AI新創公司Anthropic已與IREN簽署多年期雲端服務合約，帶動市場關注AI算力租賃與資料中心需求。

International oil prices stayed above $100 a barrel as investors watched Middle‑East developments, upcoming bank earnings, and this week’s U.S. inflation data to gauge the Fed’s next rate move.
At 5:36 a.m. Eastern Time, Dow futures were up 0.08%, S&P 500 futures rose 0.12%, while Nasdaq‑100 futures slipped 0.05%, giving a mixed picture across the three major index futures.

Oil prices continue to be driven by geopolitics. U.S. President Trump said Russia and Ukraine have agreed to stop attacking each other’s energy facilities, though details remain unclear, and a deadly attack on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport over the weekend keeps Middle‑East tensions high, supporting Brent crude above $100 a barrel.

IG chief market analyst Chris Beauchamp noted that although markets had hoped a U.S.–Russia energy pact would push prices lower, the renewed escalation in the Middle East means oil could remain a key market‑sentiment driver this week.

On the earnings front, the U.S. Q3 earnings season kicks off on Tuesday with major banks such as Wells Fargo (WFC‑US), Goldman Sachs (GS‑US), Citigroup (C‑US) and JPMorgan Chase (JPM‑US) slated to report. Analysts expect S&P 500 companies to post a 30.6% year‑over‑year Q3 profit increase, and they will watch whether AI‑related spending and profit growth meet expectations.

Higher oil prices are also reviving inflation concerns. U.S. Treasury yields earlier this month rose to a 24‑year high, prompting worries that rising energy costs could keep inflation elevated and limit the Fed’s room to adjust rates.

The market projects that this week’s U.S. Consumer Price Index will show a 0.6% month‑over‑month increase and a 3.7% year‑over‑year rise; core CPI is expected to rise 0.2% month‑over‑month and 2.5% year‑over‑year.
